name: Core
description: Control flow, variables and runtime built-ins.

actions.name: Exit loop
actions.description: Leave the loop now and carry on after it; name a loop to leave an outer one.

label.description: Label of the loop to leave; the innermost loop when empty.

actions.name: Comment
actions.description: A note in the steps for people reading the agent; it does nothing when the agent runs.

actions.name: Continue loop
actions.description: Skip the rest of this pass and start the next pass of the loop; name a loop to continue an outer one.

label.description: Label of the loop to continue; the innermost loop when empty.

actions.name: Delay
actions.description: Wait a fixed time, or a random time between two values, before the next step.

seconds.description: Time to wait (in the chosen unit); the low end of the range for a random delay.

random_max.description: High end of a random delay; each run waits a random time between seconds and this value.

actions.name: Exit subflow
actions.description: Leave the subflow now; the agent carries on after the step that ran it (Finally steps still run).

actions.name: Go to
actions.description: Jump to a Label in the same list of steps or one around it. Kept for agents moved from other tools; a Loop, If or subflow is easier to follow.

label.description: Name of the Label to carry on from.

actions.name: If
actions.description: Run the steps inside when the condition is true; otherwise try each Else if, then Else.

actions.name: Watch for interruptions
actions.description: Run the steps inside while watching for interruptions such as a pop-up: when a handler's condition becomes true, its steps run and the agent carries on.

title.description: What the watched steps do, shown in OneAgentStudio.

check_every_seconds.description: How often the handlers are checked while the agent waits (Delay, Wait for condition, keep checking); they are always checked before each toolkit step.

retry_failed_step.description: When a step fails and a handler then finds and deals with an interruption, run that step once more.

actions.name: Label
actions.description: A named place in the steps that Go to can jump to; it does nothing itself.

name.description: Name of the place, unique among the labels Go to steps can see.

actions.name: Log message
actions.description: Write a message to the run log.

message.description: Text to log; ${...} interpolation allowed.

actions.name: Loop
actions.description: Repeat the steps inside: a number of times, while a condition holds, or once for each item, row, file, e-mail and so on.

iterator.description: Iterator kind or package/iterator address; triggers waits for the events of the loop's handlers and runs the steps of the handler whose event came first.

over.description: Collection for list, dictionary and table_rows iterators.

condition.description: Condition for the while iterator, checked before each pass.

as.description: Declared variable that receives the current item.

index.description: Declared Number variable that receives the zero-based index.

columns_to.description: Column name to a declared variable: each pass puts that column of the current row (or key of the current record) in the variable.

max_iterations.description: Safety limit; the loop fails with LOOP.LIMIT when reached.

from_index.description: First zero-based item or row to visit (list, dictionary, table and toolkit iterators); from the first when empty.

to_index.description: Last zero-based item or row to visit, included; up to the last when empty.

step.description: Visit every n-th item; for the times iterator, the amount the counter grows each pass.

start.description: First counter value for the times iterator.

reverse.description: Visit the items in reverse order (list, dictionary, table and toolkit iterators).

check_at_end.description: While iterator: check the condition after each pass, so the children run at least once.

label.description: Name of this loop, so Exit loop and Continue loop inside nested loops can target it.

actions.name: Parallel
actions.description: Run each step inside at the same time, and wait until all of them have finished.

actions.name: Pause agent
actions.description: Stop and wait until someone presses Resume in OneAgentStudio or One CommandCenter, or until the time limit.

message.description: Why the run is waiting; shown with the paused run.

timeout_seconds.description: Resume by itself after this many seconds; waits until resumed when empty.

actions.name: Run Agent
actions.description: Run another agent with the inputs you give it, and keep the outputs it gives back.

inputs.description: Values for the child's input variables.

output_map.description: Child output name to the variable of this agent that receives it, e.g. {"total": "invoice_total"}.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the child with CHILD.TIMEOUT when one run takes longer than this; no limit when empty.

same_session.description: Share this agent's open sessions (workbooks, browsers, connections) with the child; sessions the child opens stay open for this agent.

fail_on_error.description: Fail this step when the child fails; when off, set status to failed and the error output and carry on.

repeat.description: Run the child this many times in a row.

repeat_mode.description: How often the child runs: a number of times, again and again for a length of time, or again and again until the run is stopped.

repeat_for_seconds.description: Start the child again until this many seconds have passed since the first run began; a run that has started always finishes.

outputs.description: The child's output variables (of the last run when repeated).

status.description: Child run status: success or failed.

error.description: The child's error (code, message, stepId) when it failed and fail_on_error is off; empty otherwise.

runs.description: How many times the child ran.

actions.name: Run subflow
actions.description: Run one of this agent's subflows (a named list of steps kept beside the main steps), then carry on; it shares the agent's variables.

subflow.description: Name of the subflow to run.

actions.name: Assign variable
actions.description: Put a value, or the result of a calculation, in a variable.

actions.name: Assign several variables
actions.description: Put values in several variables in one step, in order: a later value can use a variable set above it.

assignments.description: Records with variable (a declared variable's name) and value (a value, $reference or {"expr": ...}).

actions.name: State machine
actions.description: Move between named states: each state runs its steps, then the first transition whose condition holds takes the agent to the next state, until a final state.and moves to the next state; the step ends in a final state. Fails with STATE.NO_TRANSITION when a state that is not final has no true transition.

initial.description: Name of the state to start in; the first state when empty.

max_transitions.description: Safety limit; the step fails with STATE.LIMIT when more transitions than this are taken.

actions.name: Step
actions.description: A named group of steps that keeps the agent tidy; it changes nothing when the agent runs.

title.description: Group title shown in OneAgentStudio.

actions.name: Stop agent
actions.description: End the agent now with the status you choose; Finally steps still run.

message.description: Reason written to the run log.

status.description: success ends the agent normally; failed ends it with error AGENT.STOPPED.

actions.name: Switch
actions.description: Compare one value with each case in turn and run the steps of the first case that matches; Default runs when none does.

value.description: Value to compare with each case's values: text, a number, a $reference or an expression.

match.description: How a case value matches: equals (like ==, so 5 and "5" match), contains, starts_with, ends_with, regex (the case value is a pattern), or expression (each case value is a condition and the value is not used).

actions.name: Throw error
actions.description: Raise an error with a code of your choice, for a Catch (or On error) to handle.

message.description: What went wrong, for the log and the Catch; the code when empty.

details.description: Extra values carried with the error, readable in Catch.

retryable.description: Mark the error as temporary so retry policies try the step again.

actions.name: Try
actions.description: Run the steps inside; if one fails, run the first Catch that takes the error, then always Finally.

actions.name: Wait for condition
actions.description: Wait until a condition is true, checking it again and again, up to a time limit.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait.

fail_on_timeout.description: Fail with WAIT.TIMEOUT when the time runs out; when off, carry on and set met to false.

met.description: True when the condition became true before the timeout.

conditions.name: Child agent succeeded
conditions.description: Run another agent (its production version) and be true when it ends without an error, false when it fails.

automation.description: Id of the published agent to run.

inputs.description: Values for the child's input variables.

conditions.name: Session is open
conditions.description: True when a session with this name is open in this run: a workbook, browser, database connection or any other toolkit's session.

session.description: Session name, as given on the step that opened it (for example excel, browser or db).

name: Active Directory
description: Create, change, move and delete users, groups, computers and organizational units, reset passwords and manage group membership in Active Directory or LDAP.

actions.name: Add users to group
actions.description: Add one or more users to a group (no error for users already in it).

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

group_dn.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

more_usernames.description: More users to add in the same step (logon name, full name or distinguished name each).

changed.description: How many users were added (users already in the group are not counted).

actions.name: Build distinguished name
actions.description: Turn a readable path such as Corp/Sales/EMEA and a domain into a distinguished name (OU=EMEA,OU=Sales,OU=Corp,DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com), optionally ending with a user, group or computer name.

path.description: Organizational units from the top down, separated by /; may start with the domain (corp.example.com/Corp/Sales).

domain.description: DNS name of the domain; taken from the start of path when empty.

name.description: Name of the object at the end (its common name); the container's own name when empty.

name_kind.description: CN for users, groups and computers; OU when name is an organizational unit.

path_kind.description: auto makes path parts organizational units, except built-in containers such as Users or Computers at the top (CN=); ou or cn forces one kind.

parent_dn.description: The distinguished name of the container (without the name).

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Sign in to Active Directory or an LDAP server.

url.description: Server address. ldaps:// (or ldap:// with StartTLS) is recommended for everything and needed for password changes. The form LDAP://dc01/DC=corp,DC=example,DC=com is accepted too; the part after the host is the base DN.

bind_user.description: User to sign in as (UPN or distinguished name).

password.description: Password from the vault.

base_dn.description: Where searches start; taken from the address when it has one.

connect_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the server to accept the connection.

read_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for each answer from the server.

follow_referrals.description: Follow referrals to other domain controllers; turn off to ignore them.

start_tls.description: Encrypt an ldap:// connection with StartTLS before signing in (for domain controllers that require signing or encryption).

ca_file.description: Certificate of the company CA that issued the domain controller's certificate (PEM or DER), when it is not in the Windows certificate store.

actions.name: Create computer
actions.description: Create a computer account so a machine can join the domain.

container_dn.description: Distinguished name of the organizational unit or container to create it in; the session's base (Connect) when empty.

dn.description: Distinguished name of the new computer.

actions.name: Create group
actions.description: Create a security or distribution group.

container_dn.description: Distinguished name of the organizational unit or container to create it in; the session's base (Connect) when empty.

name.description: Group name (also its sAMAccountName unless given).

scope.description: Group scope: global (the Windows default) for people of this domain, domain_local for permissions in this domain, universal across the forest.

group_type.description: Security groups can be used in permissions; distribution groups only for mail.

sam_account_name.description: Pre-Windows 2000 name; the group name when empty.

dn.description: Distinguished name of the new group.

actions.name: Create organizational unit
actions.description: Create an organizational unit.

parent_dn.description: Distinguished name of the parent domain or organizational unit; the session's base (Connect) when empty.

dn.description: Distinguished name of the new organizational unit.

actions.name: Create user
actions.description: Create a user account in an organizational unit, optionally with a first password, and enable it.

container_dn.description: Distinguished name of the organizational unit or container to create it in; the session's base (Connect) when empty.

username.description: Sign-in name (sAMAccountName, up to 20 characters).

display_name.description: Display name; also the object name. First and last name when empty.

password.description: First password from the vault (needs an ldaps:// connection); the account stays disabled without one.

enabled.description: Enable the account once the password is set.

must_change_password.description: Require a password change at first sign-in.

password_never_expires.description: Create the account with a password that never expires (only when no change is required at first sign-in).

email.description: Email address (stored in mail).

title.description: Job title.

cannot_change_password.description: Stop the user from changing their own password (Active Directory only; only when no change is required at first sign-in).

dn.description: Distinguished name of the new user.

actions.name: Delete computer
actions.description: Delete a computer account.

computer.description: Computer distinguished name, or its name (with or without the trailing $).

actions.name: Delete group
actions.description: Delete a group (its members are not deleted).

group.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

actions.name: Delete organizational unit
actions.description: Delete an organizational unit; with recursive, everything inside it is deleted too.

ou.description: Organizational unit distinguished name, or its name when unique.

recursive.description: Also delete every object inside it (cannot be undone).

actions.name: Delete user
actions.description: Delete a user account.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

actions.name: Disable user
actions.description: Disable a user account (for example when someone leaves).

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the directory session.

actions.name: Enable user
actions.description: Enable a disabled user account.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

actions.name: Get computer properties
actions.description: Read attributes of a computer account.

computer.description: Computer distinguished name, or its name (with or without the trailing $).

attributes.description: Attributes to read, e.g. ["operatingSystem","dNSHostName"]; all when empty.

properties.description: dn plus the requested attributes (all readable ones when none are listed).

value.description: When exactly one attribute is asked for: its value on its own (text, or a list for several values).

actions.name: Get group members
actions.description: List the members of a group, optionally including members of nested groups.

group.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

recursive.description: Include members of nested groups (Active Directory only).

member_type.description: Only return members of this kind.

return_as.description: table: a row per member; names: a list of their names; dns: a list of their distinguished names.

table.description: Columns: dn, name, sAMAccountName, type, mail.

list.description: With return as names or distinguished names: the members as a plain list.

actions.name: Get group properties
actions.description: Read attributes of a group.

group.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

attributes.description: Attributes to read, e.g. ["description","managedBy"]; all when empty.

properties.description: dn plus the requested attributes (all readable ones when none are listed).

value.description: When exactly one attribute is asked for: its value on its own (text, or a list for several values).

actions.name: Get OU properties
actions.description: Read attributes of an organizational unit.

ou.description: Organizational unit distinguished name, or its name when unique.

attributes.description: Attributes to read, e.g. ["description","managedBy"]; all when empty.

properties.description: dn plus the requested attributes (all readable ones when none are listed).

value.description: When exactly one attribute is asked for: its value on its own (text, or a list for several values).

actions.name: Get user
actions.description: Read a user's properties, finding the user by logon name, full name or distinguished name.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

attributes.description: More attributes to read, e.g. ["employeeID","physicalDeliveryOfficeName"]; the usual set is always returned.

user.description: dn, sAMAccountName, displayName, mail, enabled, locked and more.

value.description: When exactly one attribute is asked for: its value on its own (text, or a list for several values).

actions.name: Move computer
actions.description: Move a computer account to another organizational unit.

computer.description: Computer distinguished name, or its name (with or without the trailing $).

target_ou_dn.description: Distinguished name of the destination organizational unit.

actions.name: Move group
actions.description: Move a group to another organizational unit; its members stay.

group.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

target_ou_dn.description: Distinguished name of the destination organizational unit.

actions.name: Move organizational unit
actions.description: Move an organizational unit, with everything in it, under another parent.

ou.description: Organizational unit distinguished name, or its name when unique.

target_parent_dn.description: Distinguished name of the new parent.

actions.name: Move user
actions.description: Move a user to another organizational unit.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

target_ou_dn.description: Distinguished name of the destination organizational unit.

actions.name: Remove users from group
actions.description: Remove one or more users from a group (no error for users not in it).

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

group_dn.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

more_usernames.description: More users to remove in the same step (logon name, full name or distinguished name each).

actions.name: Rename computer
actions.description: Rename a computer account (object name and sAMAccountName); the machine itself is not renamed.

computer.description: Computer distinguished name, or its name (with or without the trailing $).

new_name.description: New computer name (up to 15 characters).

actions.name: Rename group
actions.description: Change a group's name, optionally also its pre-Windows 2000 name.

group.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

new_name.description: New group name.

update_sam_account_name.description: Also change the sAMAccountName to the new name.

actions.name: Rename organizational unit
actions.description: Change the name of an organizational unit.

ou.description: Organizational unit distinguished name, or its name when unique.

new_name.description: New name.

actions.name: Rename user
actions.description: Change the object name of a user (optionally also its display name), its sign-in name (sAMAccountName and the part of the UPN before @), or both.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

new_name.description: New object name (common name), e.g. Jane Doe; also the new sign-in name when only the sign-in name is renamed and new_sign_in_name is empty.

update_display_name.description: Also set the display name to the new name (when the object name changes).

rename_target.description: object: the object name only (the sign-in name is kept); sign_in: the sign-in name only; both: object name and sign-in name.

new_sign_in_name.description: New sign-in name (sAMAccountName, up to 20 characters); new_name is used when empty.

actions.name: Reset password
actions.description: Set a new password (needs an ldaps:// connection), optionally forcing a change at next sign-in.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

new_password.description: New password from the vault or a Credential variable.

must_change.description: Require a change at next sign-in.

actions.name: Run LDAP query
actions.description: Run a raw LDAP filter from any starting point and scope and return the entries as a table.

attributes.description: Attributes to return; cn, sAMAccountName and mail when empty.

base_dn.description: Where to start; the session's base when empty.

scope.description: How deep to search below the starting point.

return_as.description: table: a row per entry; names: a list of their names (the first attribute, else the name in the dn); dns: a list of distinguished names.

table.description: One row per entry; columns are dn plus the requested attributes.

list.description: With return as names or distinguished names: the entries as a plain list.

actions.name: Search
actions.description: Run an LDAP filter and return matching entries as a table.

table.description: One row per entry; columns are dn plus the requested attributes.

actions.name: Set user property
actions.description: Change one attribute of a user, e.g. title or telephoneNumber; values can be replaced, added or removed.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

mode.description: replace: set the value; add: add one more value to a multi-valued attribute; remove: remove this one value.

actions.name: Set computer property
actions.description: Change one attribute of a computer account, e.g. description or location.

computer.description: Computer distinguished name, or its name (with or without the trailing $).

value.description: New value, or a list for several values; empty clears it.

actions.name: Set group property
actions.description: Change one attribute of a group, e.g. description or managedBy.

group.description: Group distinguished name, or its sAMAccountName or common name.

value.description: New value, or a list for several values; empty clears it.

actions.name: Set OU property
actions.description: Change one attribute of an organizational unit, e.g. description or managedBy.

ou.description: Organizational unit distinguished name, or its name when unique.

value.description: New value, or a list for several values; empty clears it.

actions.name: Set password
actions.description: Set a user's password as an administrator (needs an ldaps:// connection), optionally unlocking the account.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

new_password.description: New password from the vault or a Credential variable.

must_change.description: Require a change at next sign-in.

actions.name: Unlock user
actions.description: Unlock an account locked by failed sign-ins.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

actions.name: Update account options
actions.description: Turn account options on or off: enabled, password never expires, and must change password at next sign-in; empty options stay as they are.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

must_change_password.description: Whether a password change is required at next sign-in.

smart_card_required.description: Whether a smart card is required for interactive sign-in.

not_delegated.description: Whether the account is sensitive and cannot be delegated.

password_not_required.description: Whether the account may have an empty password (normally false).

no_kerberos_preauth.description: Whether Kerberos pre-authentication is not required (normally false).

account_expires.description: Last day the account can be used (yyyy-MM-dd, the account ends at the start of the next day UTC), or never.

cannot_change_password.description: Whether the user is stopped from changing their own password (Active Directory only; changes the object's permissions).

user_account_control.description: The account control flags after the change.

actions.name: Update user details
actions.description: Change several details of a user in one step (names, description, office, phone, email, title, department, manager and any other attributes); empty inputs stay as they are.

username.description: Logon name (sAMAccountName or UPN), full name, or distinguished name.

email.description: Email address (mail).

title.description: Job title.

manager.description: Manager: a distinguished name, or a sAMAccountName or UPN that is looked up.

attributes.description: Any other attributes, e.g. {"employeeID": "E123"}; an empty value clears the attribute.

changed.description: Names of the attributes that were changed.

name: AI Agents
description: Run an AI agent that works toward a goal using your agents as tools, with approvals and limits.

actions.name: Run AI agent
actions.description: Give an agent a goal and a set of agents it may use; it plans, calls the agents and returns its final answer and a trace.

goal.description: What the agent should achieve, e.g. the customer email to handle.

instructions.description: Role, policy and rules for the agent.
instructions.default: You are a careful business assistant. Use the tools to act; never invent results.

tools.description: Ids of the agents it may call, e.g. ["lookup_order", "check_refund_policy"].

sensitive_tools.description: Agent ids that need a person's approval before each call (e.g. issue_refund).

provider.description: Who runs the model: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), Hugging Face (its router or your own TGI server), AWS SageMaker (a model on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint), AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI (Gemini).

connection.description: Name of a Model Connection (provider, model and key managed in one place). Leave empty to set them on this action.

model.description: Model name; the deployment name for Azure OpenAI; the endpoint name for AWS SageMaker; the model or inference profile id for AWS Bedrock.

api_key.description: API key or access token from the vault (not needed for some self-hosted endpoints). For AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker: the AWS secret access key (or ACCESS_KEY_ID:SECRET). For Google Vertex AI: a service-account JSON key or an access token.

base_url.description: Endpoint; required for Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI (https://REGION-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/REGION) and self-hosted models (for a TGI server, e.g. http://tgi-host:8080/v1).

max_steps.description: Maximum model turns. New steps start at 25, room for longer tasks; steps saved before keep their own value (8 when they never set one).

max_tokens_total.description: Stop when this many tokens have been used.

mask_pii.description: Replace emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs and similar before sending; restored in the answer.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker only: AWS access key id from the vault (api_key then holds the secret access key).

aws_region.description: AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker only: AWS region, e.g. eu-west-1.

role.description: Who the agent acts as; added in front of the instructions.

action_plan.description: The order in which to use the tools and when to stop or ask a person, in plain words.

output_fields.description: Values the agent must return, name to description; they come back in outputs. Plain text answer when empty.

allow_cancel.description: Let the agent end with status cancelled when the goal should not be pursued (with output fields only).

max_duration_seconds.description: Stop with limit_reached after this many seconds; no time limit when 0.

forms.description: Forms from the form designer the agent may show to the person at the runner, as tools, to ask for information or a decision (attended runners).

form_timeout_seconds.description: How long a form waits for the person; no answer is reported to the agent as not answered.

toxicity_guardrail.description: Check the goal, the model's answers and the arguments it gives tools for toxic language (threats, self-harm, hate, insults, swearing): log records it in the trace; block stops the agent with status blocked.

toxicity_level.description: From which level the guardrail acts: high only threats, self-harm and hate; medium also insults and explicit content; low also swearing.

blocked_terms.description: Your own words or phrases the guardrail treats as high, e.g. competitor names or internal code names.

approvers.description: When nobody is at the runner, a sensitive tool's approval goes to the Task inbox of these people (user:NAME or role:NAME, separated by commas). Empty: denied at once.

approval_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for an answer in the Task inbox; no answer means no.

knowledge_indexes.description: Knowledge indexes (Knowledge Q&A > Build index) the agent searches itself for facts, with a search_knowledge tool.

mcp_server_url.description: An MCP server whose tools the agent may use (Streamable HTTP).

mcp_token.description: The MCP server's bearer token, when it needs one.

mcp_tools.description: Which of the server's tools it may use (names); empty: all. Name them in sensitive_tools as mcp:NAME to need approval.

goal_file.description: A text file holding the goal, read as UTF-8 when the step runs (at most 1 MB).

workspace_folder.description: The folder the agent's tools may work in: file paths the model gives agents are kept inside it (one outside is refused), agents with a workspace_folder input receive it, and forms and knowledge indexes must be inside it. Any folder when empty.

credentials.description: Credentials from the vault the agents it runs may use, by the name of their Credential input. They are handed over directly and never shown to the model.

status.description: completed, limit_reached, stopped or blocked (by the toxicity guardrail); with output fields also failed or cancelled, as the agent decided.

outputs.description: The output fields asked for (empty when none were).

trace.description: Each model turn and tool call, for review and audit.

main.tick: Let the agent ask a person with forms

more.tick: Ask approvers in the Task inbox when nobody is at the runner

name: AI screen (vision)
description: Find and click controls on the screen from a plain description, with a vision model.

actions.name: Click described control (AI)
actions.description: Find a control on the screen from a plain description with a vision model, and click it; fails when it is not found.

description.description: The control in plain words: its text, kind, colour or place.

connection.description: Model Connection to use instead of the skill's own provider and model.

name: Application
description: Open files, start, run and stop programs on the runner.

actions.name: Close command session
actions.description: End a command session: optionally ask the program to exit, then stop it and every program it started.

session.description: Name of the command session, from Open command session.

send_exit.description: Send the line exit first, so the program can end by itself.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for it to end by itself before it is stopped.

exit_code.description: The program's exit code (1 when it had to be stopped).

actions.name: Open file
actions.description: Open a document with its default application, e.g. a PDF in the PDF viewer. Kept for older agents: new ones use Open program/file.

actions.name: Open program/file
actions.description: Open a program with its parameters, or a file in the application that opens it (a PDF in the PDF viewer).

location.description: The program or file to open: browse for it or type its path. A $variable works too.

parameters.description: For a program: what to pass to it, as typed after it on a command line. Words in quotes stay together.

start_in.description: For a program: the folder it starts in. Empty: the agent's working folder.

wait_seconds.description: Pause this long after opening so its window can appear; 0 continues at once.

wait_for_window.description: For a program: go on as soon as its window shows, waiting at most wait_seconds (G4); off always pauses the whole time.

process_id.description: The program's process id, for Stop program; 0 when a file was opened in its application.

actions.name: Open command session
actions.description: Start a console program such as cmd.exe or powershell.exe and keep it open, so later steps can write to it and read its output.

program.description: Console program to run: cmd.exe, powershell.exe or any program that reads its standard input.

arguments.description: Arguments, one list item each. For powershell.exe or pwsh with none, it reads commands from this session (-NoLogo -NoProfile -Command -).

working_folder.description: Folder to start in; the workspace when empty.

output_encoding.description: Text encoding of what is written and read: console (the code page console programs use here), utf-8 (any language; the program runs in a UTF-8 console, but cmd.exe itself can then only take ASCII typed text), or a name such as cp850.

environment.description: Extra environment variables for the program; an empty value removes one.

session.description: Name for this session; later steps use it.

actions.name: Read command session
actions.description: Read what the program of a command session printed, optionally waiting until some text (e.g. its prompt) appears.

session.description: Name of the command session, from Open command session.

wait_for.description: Wait until this appears in the output, e.g. the prompt or a question. Empty: return what is there once the output has been quiet for half a second.

match_type.description: How wait_for is matched: as plain text, or as a regular expression, e.g. [A-Z]:\\.*>$ for any cmd prompt.

timeout_seconds.description: Longest time to wait.

from.description: new: only output since the last read; all: everything the session has printed (the newest 2,000,000 characters).

fail_on_timeout.description: When wait_for does not appear in time (or the program ends first), fail the step; off: return with matched false.

output.description: The output read (up to the end of wait_for when it was found); secrets written to the session show as ****.

exited.description: True when the program has ended.

exit_code.description: The program's exit code once it has ended; -1 while it runs.

actions.name: Run program and wait
actions.description: Run a program, wait for it to finish and return its exit code and output.

arguments.description: Arguments, one list item each (no shell quoting needed).

working_folder.description: Folder to run in; the workspace when empty.

input.description: Text sent to the program's standard input.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum run time.

fail_on_error.description: Fail the step when the exit code is not 0.

environment.description: Extra environment variables for the program.

output_encoding.description: Text encoding of the program's input and output, e.g. utf-8, cp850, windows-1252.

allow_shell_operators.description: For cmd.exe and .bat/.cmd files only: let arguments contain & | < > ^ or quotes, which cmd reads as command operators. Leave off when arguments carry data (file names, e-mail subjects): such characters are then refused, so data can never run a command.

actions.name: Start program
actions.description: Start a program and continue without waiting; returns its process id.

arguments.description: Arguments, one list item each.

window_state.description: How the program's main window opens (Windows); other systems always use normal.

environment.description: Extra environment variables for the program; an empty value removes one.

wait_seconds.description: Pause this long after starting so the program can open its window; 0 continues at once.

allow_shell_operators.description: For cmd.exe and .bat/.cmd files only: let arguments contain & | < > ^ or quotes, which cmd reads as command operators. Leave off when arguments carry data (file names, e-mail subjects): such characters are then refused, so data can never run a command.

process_id.description: Process id, used by Stop program.

actions.name: Stop program
actions.description: Stop a program by process id or by program name (e.g. EXCEL.EXE).

force.description: Force-stop if it does not close normally.

actions.name: Write to command session
actions.description: Send a line of text, or a password from the vault, to the program of a command session, as if typed.

session.description: Name of the command session, from Open command session.

text.description: Text to send, e.g. a command or an answer to a question.

secret.description: A Credential to send instead, e.g. at a password prompt. It is never logged, and if the program prints it back, reads show **** instead.

press_enter.description: End with Enter, so the program takes the line.

conditions.name: Program is running
conditions.description: True when a process with this program file name is running.

name.description: Program file name, e.g. EXCEL.EXE, or its full path, e.g. C:\Tools\app.exe (G4).

wait_seconds.description: Keep trying this many seconds until it runs; 0 checks once (G4).

actions.name: List tasks
actions.description: List the tasks of a project, of a section, or assigned to a user in a workspace.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

project_id.description: List the tasks of this project.

section_id.description: Or list the tasks of this section: its id, or Project name/Section name.

assignee.description: Or list tasks assigned to this user (id, email or me); also needs workspace_id.

modified_since.description: Only tasks changed at or after this time (ISO 8601).

max_results.description: Most items to return; pages are read until this many are found.

project_ids.description: Or the tasks of several projects, one after another (G5).

completed_since.description: Only tasks not completed, or completed at or after this time (ISO 8601) (G5).

table.description: Columns: gid, name, completed, assignee, due_on, modified_at, url.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

max_results.description: Most items to return; pages are read until this many are found.

actions.name: List teams of user
actions.description: List the teams a person belongs to in an organization workspace.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

user.description: User id, an email address, or me for the token's own user.

max_results.description: Most items to return; pages are read until this many are found.

actions.name: List users
actions.description: List the people in a workspace.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

max_results.description: Most items to return; pages are read until this many are found.

team_id.description: Only the people of this team (G5).

actions.name: List workspaces

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

actions.name: Remove followers
actions.description: Stop people from following a task.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

task_id.description: Task id: the long number at the end of the task's link, e.g. 1208000000000001.

followers.description: Users to remove: ids, emails or me.

actions.name: Remove tag from task
actions.description: Take a tag off a task.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

task_id.description: Task id: the long number at the end of the task's link, e.g. 1208000000000001.

tag_id.description: The tag: its name or id.

actions.name: Search tasks
actions.description: Search a workspace for tasks by text, assignee, project or completion (needs a paid Asana plan). Returns up to 100 tasks, most recently changed first.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

text.description: Words to look for in task names and descriptions.

assignee.description: Only tasks assigned to this user (id or me).

completed.description: true for done tasks only, false for open tasks only; empty for both.

table.description: Columns: gid, name, completed, assignee, due_on, modified_at, url.

actions.name: Update comment
actions.description: Change the text of a comment (only the comment's author can), or pin or unpin it.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

comment_id.description: Comment id, from Add comment or List comments.

text.description: New comment text; leave empty to keep the text and only pin or unpin.

text_format.description: plain sends the text as it is; html sends Asana rich text, wrapped in ..., e.g. Paid today.

pinned.description: true pins the comment to the top of the task, false unpins it; empty leaves it as it is.

actions.name: Update project
actions.description: Change a project's name, notes, colour, owner, due date or archived state; empty inputs are left as they are.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

project_id.description: The project: its name, or its id (the long number in its link, e.g. 1207000000000001).

owner.description: User id, an email address, or me for the token's own user.

fields.description: Other project fields by their API name, e.g. {"color": "dark-green"}.

actions.name: Update task
actions.description: Change a task's name, notes, assignee, due date, completion, custom fields or parent task. Only the inputs you fill in are changed.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

task_id.description: Task id: the long number at the end of the task's link, e.g. 1208000000000001.

assignee.description: New assignee: user id, email or me; none to unassign.

completed.description: true marks the task done, false reopens it.

custom_fields.description: Custom field id to new value.

parent_task_id.description: Move the task under this parent task, making it a subtask; none makes it a top-level task again.

actions.name: Update team
actions.description: Rename a team or change its description.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

actions.name: Upload attachment
actions.description: Attach a local file to a task.

base_url.description: API address. Keep the default unless your company routes Asana through a proxy.

token.description: Personal access token or OAuth token from the vault. Or leave it empty and choose a connection that signs in, which gets and renews the token.

task_id.description: Task id: the long number at the end of the task's link, e.g. 1208000000000001.

path.description: Local file to attach (Asana accepts up to 100 MB).

file_name.description: Name to give the attachment; the local file name when empty.

name: AWS AI services
description: Read sentiment, entities, language and personal data in text with Amazon Comprehend, text, forms and tables from scans with Amazon Textract, and labels and text in pictures with Amazon Rekognition.

actions.name: Detect language
actions.description: Find which language a text is written in (Amazon Comprehend).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 100,000 bytes.

language.description: Code of the most likely language, e.g. en, de or fr.

score.description: How sure Comprehend is about that language (0 to 1).

languages.description: Every language found. Columns: language, score.

actions.name: Detect personal data
actions.description: Find personal data such as names, addresses, phone numbers, emails and card or account numbers in a text, and give a copy with them masked (Amazon Comprehend).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 100,000 bytes.

language.description: Language of the text: en or es.

min_score.description: Leave out findings scored below this (0 to 1).

entities.description: Columns: text, type, score, begin_offset, end_offset.

redacted_text.description: The text with each piece of personal data replaced by its type, e.g. [EMAIL].

count.description: How many pieces of personal data were found.

actions.name: Detect entities
actions.description: Find people, places, organisations, dates, quantities and other named things in a text (Amazon Comprehend).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 100,000 bytes.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ja, ko, zh, ar or hi.

min_score.description: Leave out entities scored below this (0 to 1).

entities.description: Columns: text, type, score, begin_offset, end_offset.

actions.name: Key phrases
actions.description: Find the main noun phrases of a text, such as "the monthly invoice" or "three new laptops" (Amazon Comprehend).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 100,000 bytes.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ja, ko, zh, ar or hi.

min_score.description: Leave out phrases scored below this (0 to 1).

actions.name: Detect sentiment
actions.description: Read whether a text is positive, negative, neutral or mixed, with a score for each (Amazon Comprehend).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 5,000 bytes.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ja, ko, zh, ar or hi.

scores.description: Score from 0 to 1 for each, e.g. {"positive": 0.97, "negative": 0.01, "neutral": 0.02, "mixed": 0}.

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Open a session for one AWS region with an access key from the vault; the Comprehend, Textract and Rekognition steps use it.

region.description: AWS region of the services, e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1 or ap-south-1.

access_key_id.description: Access key id from the vault.

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key from the vault.

session_token.description: Session token from the vault, for temporary keys (assumed roles, single sign-on).

endpoint.description: Another address for the services, e.g. a private VPC endpoint; {service} in it becomes comprehend, textract, rekognition or sts. Leave empty for AWS's addresses.

check_now.description: Check the keys with AWS straight away (a free identity check, no AI call).

account.description: The AWS account id the keys belong to (empty when the keys were not checked).

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the AWS AI session and forget its keys.

actions.name: Detect labels in a picture
actions.description: Name the objects, scenes and activities in a picture, e.g. Car, Invoice or Person, each with a confidence (Amazon Rekognition).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: PNG or JPEG picture, at most 5 MB.

min_confidence.description: Leave out labels with a lower confidence (0 to 100).

label_names.description: The label names, most confident first.

actions.name: Detect text in a picture
actions.description: Read short text in a photo or screenshot, e.g. signs, number plates or labels (Amazon Rekognition).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: PNG or JPEG picture, at most 5 MB.

min_confidence.description: Leave out text read with a lower confidence (0 to 100).

text.description: The lines found, one per line.

detections.description: Columns: text, type (LINE or WORD), confidence.

actions.name: Read forms and tables
actions.description: Read the text, the form fields (key and value) and the tables of a picture or one-page PDF; each table becomes a Data Table (Amazon Textract).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: PNG, JPEG or TIFF picture, or a one-page PDF; at most 10 MB.

forms.description: Read form fields (key and value pairs).

first_row_headers.description: Use the first row of each table as its column names.

text.description: All lines of text, one per line.

key_values.description: Form fields. Columns: key, value, confidence, page.

fields.description: Form fields as key to value, e.g. {"Invoice number:": "INV-1001"}.

tables.description: One Data Table per table found, top of the page first.

actions.name: Read text from a scan
actions.description: Read the printed and handwritten text of a picture or a one-page PDF (Amazon Textract).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: PNG, JPEG or TIFF picture, or a one-page PDF; at most 10 MB.

text.description: All lines of text, one per line.

name: AWS EC2
description: Start, stop, reboot, launch and end AWS EC2 virtual machines, read their state and tags, switch detailed monitoring on or off, and snapshot, create, attach and detach their EBS volumes.

actions.name: Attach volume
actions.description: Attach an available volume to an instance in the same availability zone, as a device name.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

volume_id.description: Id of the volume to attach.

instance_id.description: Id of the instance to attach it to.

device.description: Device name the instance sees, e.g. /dev/sdf (Linux) or xvdf (Windows).

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Open a session for one AWS region with an access key from the vault; later EC2 steps use it.

region.description: AWS region of the instances, e.g. us-east-1, eu-west-1 or ap-south-1.

access_key_id.description: Access key id from the vault.

secret_access_key.description: Secret access key from the vault.

session_token.description: Session token from the vault, for temporary keys (assumed roles, single sign-on).

endpoint.description: Another EC2 address, e.g. a private VPC endpoint. Leave empty for AWS's address for the region.

check_now.description: Check the keys and region with AWS straight away.

actions.name: Create snapshot
actions.description: Start a point-in-time copy (snapshot) of an EBS volume; AWS finishes it in the background.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

volume_id.description: Id of the volume to copy.

description.description: Text shown with the snapshot in the AWS console.

tags.description: Tags for the snapshot, e.g. {"Name": "Before patching", "Team": "Finance"}.

snapshot_id.description: Id of the new snapshot, e.g. snap-0abc1234def567890.

state.description: Snapshot state: pending until AWS has finished the copy, then completed.

start_time.description: When the snapshot was started (UTC, ISO 8601).

actions.name: Create volume
actions.description: Create an EBS volume in an availability zone, empty or restored from a snapshot.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

availability_zone.description: Availability zone for the volume; it can only be attached to instances in the same zone.

size_gib.description: Size in GiB (1-65536). 0 takes the snapshot's size when a snapshot is given.

volume_type.description: Volume type: gp3 or gp2 general purpose SSD, io1 or io2 provisioned-IOPS SSD, st1 or sc1 hard disk, standard magnetic.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot to restore the volume from. Leave empty for an empty volume.

tags.description: Tags for the volume, e.g. {"Name": "Invoice data"}.

volume_id.description: Id of the new volume, e.g. vol-0abc1234def567890.

size_gib.description: Size of the volume in GiB.

actions.name: Delete snapshot
actions.description: Delete a snapshot for good. AWS refuses while a machine image (AMI) still uses it.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

snapshot_id.description: Id of the snapshot to delete.

actions.name: Describe instances
actions.description: List instances with their state, type, addresses and tags: all of them, the ones you name, or those that match filters.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"]. Leave empty for all.

filters.description: EC2 filters, name to value or list of values, e.g. {"instance-state-name": "running", "tag:Team": ["Finance", "HR"]}.

instances.description: Columns: instance_id, name, state, instance_type, image_id, private_ip, public_ip, availability_zone, launch_time, monitoring, tags.

instance_ids.description: The ids of the instances found.

actions.name: Detach volume
actions.description: Detach a volume from its instance. Unmount it on the instance first; force only for a volume that will not detach.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

volume_id.description: Id of the volume to detach.

force.description: Force the detach; data not yet written can be lost, so use it only when a normal detach hangs.

actions.name: Disable monitoring
actions.description: Go back to basic (five-minute) monitoring for instances.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

monitoring.description: Instance id to monitoring state, e.g. disabling or disabled.

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the EC2 session and forget its keys.

actions.name: Enable monitoring
actions.description: Switch on detailed (one-minute) CloudWatch monitoring for instances.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

monitoring.description: Instance id to monitoring state, e.g. pending or enabled.

actions.name: Get instance status
actions.description: Read each instance's state and the results of AWS's system and instance health checks.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"]. Leave empty for all.

include_stopped.description: Also list instances that are not running (AWS leaves them out otherwise); off for new steps (G6).

statuses.description: Columns: instance_id, state, system_status, instance_status, availability_zone.

actions.name: Launch instances
actions.description: Create new instances from a machine image, with a name, tags and a start-up script.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_type.description: Instance type, e.g. t3.micro or m6i.large.

name.description: Name shown in the AWS console (the Name tag).

key_pair.description: Name of the key pair for signing in to the instance.

subnet_id.description: Subnet to start the instances in. Leave empty for the default.

security_group_ids.description: Security group ids. Leave empty for the default group.

tags.description: More tags, e.g. {"Team": "Finance", "CostCenter": "4711"}.

user_data.description: Start-up script or cloud-init text, run when the instance first starts.

instance_ids.description: The ids of the new instances.

instances.description: The new instances, with the same columns as Describe instances.

actions.name: List snapshots
actions.description: List snapshots owned by this account (or another owner), optionally only those of one volume or with certain tags.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

volume_id.description: Only snapshots of this volume. Leave empty for all.

tags.description: Only snapshots with these tag values, e.g. {"Team": "Finance"}.

owner.description: Whose snapshots: self (this account), amazon, or an AWS account id.

filters.description: More EC2 filters, name to value or list of values, e.g. {"status": "completed"}.

snapshots.description: Columns: snapshot_id, volume_id, state, progress, start_time, volume_size_gib, description, encrypted, owner_id, tags.

snapshot_ids.description: The ids of the snapshots found.

actions.name: Reboot instances
actions.description: Restart running instances.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

actions.name: Set tags
actions.description: Add tags to instances, or change the values of tags they already have.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

tags.description: Tag name to value, e.g. {"Name": "Invoice bot", "Team": "Finance"}.

actions.name: Start instances
actions.description: Start stopped instances; optionally wait until they are running.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

wait.description: Wait until every instance is running before going on.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds and fail with WAIT_TIMEOUT.

states.description: Instance id to its state at the end, when waiting.

actions.name: Stop instances
actions.description: Stop running instances; their disks are kept. Optionally hibernate them or force the stop, and wait until they are stopped.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

hibernate.description: Hibernate instead of stopping (the instance must be set up for it).

force.description: Force the stop without a clean shutdown, for an instance that hangs.

wait.description: Wait until every instance is stopped before going on.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds and fail with WAIT_TIMEOUT.

states.description: Instance id to its state at the end, when waiting.

actions.name: Terminate instances
actions.description: End instances for good; disks marked to be deleted on end are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

wait.description: Wait until every instance is terminated before going on.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds and fail with WAIT_TIMEOUT.

states.description: Instance id to its state at the end, when waiting.

actions.name: Wait for state
actions.description: Wait until every instance named is in a state, e.g. running after a start or stopped after a stop.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

instance_ids.description: Instances by id or by Name tag, e.g. ["i-0abc1234def567890"] or ["Invoice bot"].

timeout_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds and fail with WAIT_TIMEOUT.

states.description: Instance id to the state it was in at the end.

name: Azure AI services
description: Read sentiment, entities and personal data in text with Azure AI Language, text, fields and tables from documents with Document Intelligence, and tags, captions and text in pictures with Image Analysis.

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Open a session for an Azure AI resource with its endpoint and its key from the vault; the Language, Document Intelligence and Vision steps use it.

endpoint.description: The resource's endpoint from the Azure portal (Keys and Endpoint), e.g. https://contoso-ai.cognitiveservices.azure.com.

credential.description: The resource's key from the vault (or a Microsoft Entra access token, see credential_type).

credential_type.description: key: the resource key, sent as Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key. access_token: a Microsoft Entra token for the resource, sent as Bearer.

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the Azure AI session and forget its key.

actions.name: Analyse a document
actions.description: Read an invoice, receipt or any document's layout with a prebuilt model: its fields (e.g. vendor, total, date), key and value pairs and tables, each table as a Data Table (Azure AI Document Intelligence).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: PDF, picture (JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, HEIF) or Office file; at most 50 MB.

model.description: prebuilt-invoice: invoice fields and line items. prebuilt-receipt: receipt fields. prebuilt-layout: text, tables and structure of any document.

key_value_pairs.description: Also find key and value pairs, e.g. "Order no.: 4711" (an add-on feature).

pages.description: Only these pages, e.g. 1-3,5. Leave empty for all.

locale.description: Language hint, e.g. en-US or de-DE. Leave empty to detect it.

timeout_seconds.description: Fail if the analysis has not finished after this many seconds.

document_type.description: The kind of document found, e.g. invoice or receipt.retailMeal (empty for layout).

fields.description: Field name to value, e.g. {"InvoiceId": "INV-100", "InvoiceTotal": 110}; line items become a Data Table.

key_values.description: Key and value pairs found on the pages. Columns: key, value, confidence.

tables.description: One Data Table per table found.

actions.name: Read a document
actions.description: Read all printed and handwritten text of a PDF, picture or Office file with the prebuilt read model, page by page (Azure AI Document Intelligence).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: PDF, picture (JPEG, PNG, BMP, TIFF, HEIF) or Office file; at most 50 MB.

pages.description: Only these pages, e.g. 1-3,5. Leave empty for all.

locale.description: Language hint, e.g. en-US or de-DE. Leave empty to detect it.

timeout_seconds.description: Fail if the analysis has not finished after this many seconds.

actions.name: Recognise entities
actions.description: Find people, places, organisations, dates, quantities and other named things in a text (Azure AI Language).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 5,120 characters.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, de, fr, es or hi.

min_confidence.description: Leave out entities with a lower confidence (0 to 1).

entities.description: Columns: text, category, subcategory, confidence, offset, length.

actions.name: Find personal data
actions.description: Find personal data such as names, phone numbers, emails, addresses and ID or account numbers in a text, and get a masked copy (Azure AI Language).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 5,120 characters.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, de, fr, es or hi.

categories.description: Only look for these kinds, e.g. ["Email", "PhoneNumber", "Person"]. Leave empty for all kinds.

domain.description: phi also looks for protected health information.

min_confidence.description: Leave out findings with a lower confidence (0 to 1).

redacted_text.description: The text with the personal data masked with * characters.

entities.description: Columns: text, category, subcategory, confidence, offset, length.

count.description: How many pieces of personal data were found.

actions.name: Analyse sentiment
actions.description: Read whether a text is positive, neutral, negative or mixed, overall and sentence by sentence (Azure AI Language).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

text.description: The text to read, at most 5,120 characters.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, de, fr, es or hi.

scores.description: Confidence from 0 to 1 for each, e.g. {"positive": 0.95, "neutral": 0.04, "negative": 0.01}.

sentences.description: Columns: text, sentiment, positive, neutral, negative.

actions.name: Analyse a picture
actions.description: Describe a picture in a sentence, tag what is in it, find objects and read its text (Azure AI Vision Image Analysis 4.0).

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

file.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, WEBP, ICO, TIFF or MPO picture, at most 20 MB.

features.description: What to find: any of tags, caption, read, objects.

language.description: Language of the tags, e.g. en, de or fr (captions are in English).

gender_neutral_caption.description: Say "person" rather than "man" or "woman" in the caption.

caption.description: A sentence describing the picture (when caption is asked for).

tags.description: Columns: name, confidence.

objects.description: Columns: name, confidence, x, y, width, height.

text.description: Text read from the picture, one line per line (when read is asked for).

lines.description: Columns: text, confidence (the lowest word confidence in the line).

name: Azure DevOps
description: Work with Azure DevOps: work items and WIQL queries, comments and attachments, Git repositories and pull requests, pipelines, builds and sprints. Works with the cloud service and Azure DevOps Server.

actions.name: Comment on pull request

name: Boolean
description: Set, combine, check, convert and invert Yes/No (true/false) values.

actions.name: Combine Yes/No values
actions.description: One Yes/No from several: all of them (and), any of them (or), exactly one (xor) or none of them.

values.description: The Yes/No values, e.g. [$paid$, $shipped$, $invoiced$].

how.description: All: every one is Yes (and). Any: at least one (or). Exactly one: one and only one (xor). None: not one.

true_count.description: How many of the values are Yes.

actions.name: Compare
actions.description: Check whether two true/false values are equal or not equal.

order.description: Ordering of the two values: 1 when only the first is true, -1 when only the second is, 0 when equal.

actions.name: Number to Yes/No
actions.description: Read a number as Yes/No: 0 is No and any other number Yes, or strictly 1 Yes and 0 No.

rule.description: Non-zero: 0 is No, anything else Yes. One or zero: 1 is Yes, 0 is No, other numbers fail with BOOLEAN.INVALID.

actions.name: Text to Boolean
actions.description: Read true/false, yes/no, 1/0 (any case) from text.

text.description: Text such as Yes or false.

strict.description: Fail on text that is not a yes/no value; when off, such text (and empty text) gives false.

actions.name: Invert
actions.description: Return the opposite value.

actions.name: Set Yes/No
actions.description: Work out a Yes/No value: from a value (yes, 1, true, a non-empty text) or from a formula such as $total$ > 1000 and $country$ == 'IN'.

value.description: A Yes/No, a number (0 is No), or a text such as yes, no, true, false, 1, 0.

empty_is.description: What an empty value means, and what other text means (any text other than a no-word is Yes when this is no or yes).

formula.description: A condition with variables, e.g. $total$ > 1000 and $country$ == 'IN', or contains($subject$, 'urgent').

actions.name: Boolean to number
actions.description: Turn true into 1 and false into 0.

actions.name: Boolean to text
actions.description: Turn a Boolean into custom text, e.g. Approved/Rejected.

conditions.name: Is No (false)
conditions.description: True when the value is No: false, no, 0, empty or missing.

conditions.name: Is Yes (true)
conditions.description: True when the value is Yes: true, yes, 1, or a non-empty text other than a no-word.

actions.description: Connect to an Edge or Chrome that is already running, through its DevTools debugging port, and use it as a named session. Only a browser started with a debugging port can be reached (use Start browser for automation, or start it with --remote-debugging-port); a browser opened the usual way has none. Closing the session later only disconnects; the browser stays open.

endpoint.description: Debugging address of the browser: http://host:port, just the port, or a ws:// DevTools address.

browser.description: Which browser it is; found out from the browser itself when left empty. Used by window choices that name a browser.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the connection, in milliseconds.

title.description: Title of the session's current tab.

url.description: Address of the session's current tab.

tab_count.description: Number of open tabs in the browser.

window.description: A window choice for this session, to pass as the window of element actions.

actions.name: Call JavaScript function
actions.description: Call a function defined by the page (e.g. app.calculateTotal) with arguments and return its result.

function.description: Function name, reachable from window; dots for nested objects.

arguments.description: Arguments, in order (text, numbers, true/false, lists and dictionaries).

return_type.description: What the function returns: the result is checked and converted (none ignores it).

window.description: Which window to act in. Leave empty to use the session's current tab. {"source": "browser", "title": "Invoice * - Shop", "title_match": "wildcard", "url": "...", "url_match": "contains", "browser": "edge"} switches to the first open tab whose title and/or address matches (also in attached browsers, and in one listening on port 9222); {"source": "variable", "variable": "session name"} uses that browser session; {"source": "application", "title": "..."} names a desktop window, which works only when it is a window of an attached browser. Matches: wildcard (default for the title), contains (default for the address), equals or regex; text matches ignore case. Values may use variables.

frame.description: Call the function inside this iframe instead of the main page: the captured iframe element.

argument_types.description: The type of each argument, in order (G4): auto, text, number, boolean, list, dictionary or date; auto when left out.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the browser to answer (G4).

result.description: Value returned by the function (awaited when it returns a promise).

wait_after_ms.description: Pause after the action, e.g. to let the page react.
