read_receipt.description: Ask the recipient's mail program to confirm when the email is opened.

inline_images.description: HTML body only: image files embedded in the email; refer to each in the body as cid: plus its file name, e.g. .

session.description: Mailbox session whose outgoing server is used when smtp_host is empty.

body_type.description: How the body is written: plain text, HTML code, or rich text from the editor (sent as HTML).

footer.description: Text added after the body, such as a signature or a disclaimer (written like the body).

skip_missing_attachments.description: Send without an attachment whose file is missing (a warning says which) instead of failing.

skip_invalid_addresses.description: Leave out addresses that are not valid or that the server refuses (a warning says which) and send to the others.

charset.description: Character set of the subject and body, e.g. UTF-8 (the default) or ISO-8859-1.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the mail server while sending, in seconds.

message_id.description: Message-ID of the sent email.

iterators.name: Each email in a mailbox
iterators.description: Yield each email matching the Find emails filters as a dictionary: id, from, subject, received, unread, has_attachments, cc, sent, attachment_count, folder.

folder.description: Mail folder; several separated by ; and * for any text, e.g. INBOX; Invoices/*.

unread_only.description: Older steps: only unread emails. New steps choose the status instead.

from_contains.description: Sender contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

subject_contains.description: Subject contains this text; in double quotes ("Invoice 7") the whole subject must be exactly that; separate several with ; to match any of them.

since.description: Received on or after this date.

max_results.description: Stop after this many emails; 0 = no limit.

read_only.description: Older steps: only emails already read. New steps choose the status instead.

to_contains.description: A To recipient contains this text.

body_contains.description: The body contains this text (searched by the server).

oldest_first.description: Give the oldest emails first instead of the newest.

session.description: Session name of the open mailbox.

with_body.description: Give each email whole: text, HTML, recipients and attachment names (one more request per email); the email stays unread. Without it each email has id, from, subject, received, unread and has_attachments.

status.description: Which emails: any, only unread or only read.

mark_read.description: Mark each email read when the loop reaches it (IMAP only).

local_time.description: Give dates (and read since and before) in this computer's time zone instead of UTC.

name: Excel
description: Read and write .xlsx workbooks without Microsoft Office installed.

actions.name: Create worksheet
actions.description: Create a worksheet at the end or at a position; when a sheet of that name exists the step stops, unless 'replace' is ticked, which deletes that sheet and everything on it first.

name.description: Worksheet name; the next free SheetN name when empty.

replace.description: When a sheet with this name exists, delete it with all its content and create an empty one; when off, the step stops with an error instead (the default for new steps).

position.description: 1-based position among the sheets; at the end when empty.

activate.description: Make the new sheet the active one.

actions.name: Append workbook
actions.description: Copy every sheet of another workbook file to the end of this workbook; clashing names get a number suffix.

path.description: Workbook file whose sheets are copied in.

password.description: Password of that file, when it is encrypted.

actions.name: Append worksheet
actions.description: Copy one sheet, chosen by name or position, from another workbook file to the end of this workbook.

path.description: Workbook file that holds the sheet.

source_sheet.description: Sheet to copy; the first sheet when empty.

new_name.description: Name for the copy; the source name when empty.

password.description: Password of that file, when it is encrypted.

source_index.description: Position of the sheet to copy (1 = first); used when the sheet name is empty.

actions.name: Autofit columns
actions.description: Make columns just wide enough for their contents, like double-clicking a column border in Excel.

column.description: Letter or 1-based number of the first column; every used column when empty.

count.description: How many columns from the first one.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Break workbook links
actions.description: Replace formulas that refer to other workbooks, or to one chosen workbook, with their last calculated values.

link.description: Only break links to this workbook (path or file name as listed by get_links); all links when empty.

count.description: Number of formulas replaced by values.

actions.name: Get cell address
actions.description: Give the address (such as B7) of the active cell, of a row and column, or of the cell some rows below a column title.

column.description: 1-based column number or column letters.

header.description: Column title to look for in the sheet's first used row (not case-sensitive).

offset.description: How many cells below the title: 1 is the first cell under it.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

session.description: Workbook session; used for the active cell and a column title.

cell.description: Cell address.

actions.name: Change workbook link
actions.description: Point the links to one source workbook at another file; the new file should have the same sheets and cells.

old_link.description: Current source workbook (path or file name as listed by get_links).

new_link.description: Path or file name of the new source workbook.

actions.name: Clear filter
actions.description: Show every row a filter hid on a sheet and remove the sheet's Excel filter, or keep its buttons and drop only the conditions.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

keep_filter_buttons.description: Keep the filter buttons on the header row and only remove the conditions.

rows_shown.description: Number of rows that were hidden and are shown again.

actions.name: Clear range
actions.description: Clear the contents, the formats or both of a range, or of the current selection; the cells stay where they are (Delete cells moves the cells around them).

range.description: Cell or range to clear; when empty, the range chosen by select_range or the cell chosen by go_to_cell.

clear.description: contents empties the cells and keeps their formats (as the Delete key does); formats resets the formats and keeps the contents; all does both.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

count.description: Number of cells that held contents or formats and were cleared.

actions.name: Close
actions.description: Close the workbook session, saving the changes first when asked.

save.description: Save the changes to the opened file before closing (on for new steps, as AA).

fail_if_read_only.description: When the workbook was opened read-only, stop with an error instead of saving; false closes it without saving and logs a warning.

actions.name: Get column name
actions.description: Give the letters of a column, from its number (28 becomes AB), from a cell, or of the active cell.

column.description: 1-based column number.

cell.description: Cell address whose column is wanted.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

session.description: Workbook session; used for the active cell.

actions.name: Copy range
actions.description: Copy a range to another place on the same sheet or another sheet of the workbook, like copy and paste in Excel: everything, values only, formulas only or formats only. Relative cell references in formulas move with the copy.

range.description: Cells to copy.

paste.description: all copies contents and formats; values pastes the calculated values (no formulas, destination formats kept); formulas copies contents without formats; formats copies only the formats.

sheet.description: Sheet to copy from; active sheet when empty.

destination_sheet.description: Sheet to paste to; the sheet copied from when empty.

range.description: Address of the cells written, e.g. E2:G10.

actions.name: Copy worksheet
actions.description: Duplicate a worksheet inside the same workbook under a new name.

sheet.description: Sheet to copy; active sheet when empty.

new_name.description: Name for the copy; a numbered name when empty.

actions.name: Create chart
actions.description: Add a column, bar, line or pie chart of a range: the first column gives the categories, the header row the series names and each further column one series.

range.description: Data with a header row: categories in the first column, one series per further column.

chart_type.description: column (vertical bars), bar (horizontal bars), line, or pie (the first series only).

title.description: Chart title; none when empty.

position.description: Top-left cell of the chart; two columns right of the data when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet with the data; active sheet when empty.

destination_sheet.description: Sheet to put the chart on; the data sheet when empty; created when it does not exist.

range.description: Cells the chart covers, e.g. H2:O17.

actions.name: Create pivot table
actions.description: Create a pivot table from a range with a header row: fields as rows, columns, values (Sum, Count, Average, Max or Min) and filters. Excel fills in the figures when the workbook is opened.

range.description: Source range including its header row; the used area of the sheet when empty.

destination.description: Top-left cell of the pivot table.

name.description: Pivot table name; PivotTable1, PivotTable2 … when empty.

rows.description: Fields shown down the side (header names).

values.description: Fields to summarise, each as Field or Field:function, function sum (the default), count, average, max or min.

filters.description: Fields offered as report filters above the table.

sheet.description: Sheet with the source data; active sheet when empty.

destination_sheet.description: Sheet to put the pivot table on; created when it does not exist; a new sheet named Pivot when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet the pivot table is on.

actions.name: Create Excel table
actions.description: Turn a range with a header row into a named Excel table with a table style, like Ctrl+T in Excel.

range.description: Range including its header row; the used area when empty.

name.description: Table name: letters, digits, _ and ., starting with a letter; Table1, Table2 … when empty.

style.description: Excel table style: TableStyleLight1–21, TableStyleMedium1–28 or TableStyleDark1–11.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Create workbook
actions.description: Create a new empty .xlsx file on disk with one named sheet and open it as a session; optionally with a password to open, a password to edit and a sensitivity label.

sheet.description: Name of the first worksheet.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already exists at the path.

session.description: Session name used by later steps.

password.description: Encrypt the file with this password; later saves keep it encrypted.

edit_password.description: Password to modify: Excel asks for it, or offers to open the file read-only.

sensitivity_label.description: Sensitivity label id (a GUID) to put on the workbook; it may come from the vault.

label_site_id.description: Microsoft 365 tenant id (a GUID) the label belongs to.

continue_if_label_fails.description: When the label cannot be set, log a warning and go on instead of stopping.

share.description: Agents this one runs may use it.

main.tick: Require a password to open the file
Require a password to edit the file

actions.name: Delete cells
actions.description: Delete the cells of a range, or of the current selection, and close the gap by moving the cells below up or the cells to the right left.

range.description: Cell or range to delete; when empty, the range chosen by select_range or the cell chosen by go_to_cell (the sheet's active cell).

shift.description: up or left moves the remaining cells into the gap; entire_row or entire_column deletes the whole rows or columns the range touches.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Delete columns
actions.description: Delete whole columns and move the columns to the right leftwards.

column.description: Column letter or 1-based number of the first column to delete.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Delete rows
actions.description: Delete whole rows and move the rows below up.

row.description: 1-based number of the first row to delete.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Delete worksheet
actions.description: Delete a worksheet chosen by name or position.

index.description: 1-based sheet position, used instead of the name.

actions.name: Delete table column
actions.description: Remove a column from an Excel table and move the table cells to its right back by one.

column_name.description: Header of the column to remove.

column_position.description: Position of the column to remove: 1 is the table's first column.

actions.name: Fill down or right
actions.description: Copy the first row of a range down to its other rows, or its first column right to its other columns, like Excel's Fill Down and Fill Right: values, formulas (with relative references moved) and formats.

range.description: Range to fill, including the first row (or column) that is copied.

direction.description: down copies the top row to the rows below it; right copies the left column to the columns right of it.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Filter
actions.description: Return the rows of a sheet, a range or an Excel table whose value in one column matches a condition, as a Data Table; optionally also hide the other rows, or put the condition into the file as a real Excel filter.

column.description: Column to test: header name, letter or 1-based number.

operator.description: How the cell is compared with the value; between keeps values from value to value_to, both included.

value.description: Value to compare with; not needed for empty and not_empty.

match_case.description: Match upper/lower case exactly for text comparisons.

header.description: First row holds column names; the workbook's open setting (true by default) when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

value_to.description: Upper bound for the between operator.

hide_rows.description: Also hide the sheet rows that do not match (and show the ones that do), like an AutoFilter; save to keep it.

table.description: Excel table name, e.g. Table1: filter only the rows of that table (its header row gives the column names); sheet and range are then not used.

range.description: Filter only this range of the sheet; the whole used area when empty. A column letter or number still means the sheet column.

apply_in_file.description: Also put the condition into the workbook as an Excel filter: the header gets filter buttons, the other rows are hidden, and Excel shows the condition; save to keep it.

clear_existing.description: First show the rows an earlier filter hid and remove the sheet's Excel filter.

table.description: Matching rows with the sheet's column names.

actions.name: Find
actions.description: Find cells whose content contains (or equals) a text, in the whole sheet or a range; returns their addresses in search order.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

range.description: Only search this range, e.g. A1:D20; the whole sheet when empty.

whole_cell.description: Only match when the whole cell content equals the text.

look_in.description: values searches the calculated results; formulas searches the formula text of formula cells and the value of the others.

search_by.description: Order of the results: rows goes across each row first, columns goes down each column first.

start_from.description: G3 (AA parity): where the search starts: the top of the sheet, the active cell, a given cell (start_cell), or the end (searching backwards); it goes round to the start, as Excel does.

start_cell.description: The cell the search starts at.

first_cell.description: Address of the first match; empty when nothing matched.

actions.name: Find next empty cell
actions.description: Starting from a cell, walk along its column or row in a direction and return the first empty cell.

start_cell.description: Where to start; the cell chosen by go_to_cell, or A1, when empty.

direction.description: down or up searches the column, right or left searches the row.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

cell.description: Address of the first empty cell, e.g. A12.

column.description: 1-based column number of that cell.

actions.name: Format cells
actions.description: Set the number format, font, fill, alignment, wrapping and borders of a range or the selection; only the options given change, the rest of each cell's format stays.

range.description: Cell or range to format; when empty, the range chosen by select_range or the cell chosen by go_to_cell.

number_format.description: Excel number format, e.g. #,##0.00, 0%, dd/mm/yyyy, @ for text or General.

bold.description: Bold on or off; unchanged when empty.

italic.description: Italic on or off; unchanged when empty.

underline.description: Single underline on or off; unchanged when empty.

font_size.description: Font size in points; unchanged when empty.

font_color.description: Text colour: hex (#C00000), red,green,blue numbers or a name such as dark red; unchanged when empty. .xlsx only.

fill_color.description: Solid background colour, as for font_color; none removes the fill; unchanged when empty. .xlsx only.

wrap_text.description: Wrap long text onto several lines; unchanged when empty.

borders.description: all draws thin lines around every cell; outline only around the range; none removes the lines; unchanged when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Get all cells
actions.description: Read the used area of a sheet, or only rows N to M of it, as a table; the first row can be the column names.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

header.description: First row holds column names; the workbook's open setting (true by default) when empty.

read_as.description: value returns numbers, dates and booleans as such; text returns what Excel displays, with number formats applied.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden rows and columns; false returns only what is visible, as after a filter in Excel.

keep_blank_rows.description: Keep empty rows inside the data as rows of empty values instead of dropping them.

from_row.description: Only from this sheet row number on (the header row, when there is one, still gives the column names); from the first row when empty.

to_row.description: Only up to this sheet row number, included; to the last used row when empty.

actions.name: Get cell
actions.description: Read one cell, or the active cell; formulas return their calculated value, or the text as Excel displays it.

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell (set by go_to_cell) when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

read_as.description: value returns numbers, dates and booleans as such; text returns what Excel displays, with number formats applied.

actions.name: Get cell colour
actions.description: Return a cell's fill colour or font colour as a hex value such as #FFC000, or as red, green and blue numbers.

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell when empty.

target.description: fill for the background, font for the text colour.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

format.description: hex gives #RRGGBB; rgb gives three numbers separated by commas, e.g. 255,192,0.

color.description: Colour as hex or as R,G,B; empty when the cell has no colour set.

actions.name: Get current sheet name
actions.description: Return the name of the active worksheet.

actions.name: Get workbook links
actions.description: List the other workbooks this workbook's formulas refer to and the cells that use them.

cells.description: Cells with external formulas, as Sheet!A1.

table.description: One row per cell with an external formula: sheet, cell, formula.

actions.name: Get range
actions.description: Read a rectangular range such as A1:D20 as a table.

range.description: Range address.

header.description: First row holds column names; the workbook's open setting (true by default) when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

read_as.description: value returns numbers, dates and booleans as such; text returns what Excel displays, with number formats applied.

actions.name: Get sensitivity label
actions.description: Read the sensitivity label stored in the workbook's MSIP_Label custom document properties.

label_id.description: Label GUID; empty when no label is set.

name.description: Label name as stored in the file.

site_id.description: Tenant (site) id the label belongs to.

method.description: How it was applied: Standard or Privileged.

has_label.description: True when an enabled label was found.

actions.name: Get sheet names
actions.description: List the worksheet names, optionally leaving out hidden sheets.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden sheets in the list.

actions.name: Get table range
actions.description: Return the address of the smallest rectangle holding all data on the sheet (including pivot tables), or of a named Excel table or pivot table, e.g. A1:D20.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

table.description: Excel table or pivot table name, e.g. Table1 or PivotTable1; the sheet's used area when empty.

include_header.description: For an Excel table, include its header row in the range.

include_pivot_tables.description: Count the whole area of the sheet's pivot tables (with their filter fields) as data, even cells Excel has not filled in yet.

range.description: Used range address; empty when the sheet is empty.

rows.description: Number of rows in the range.

columns.description: Number of columns in the range.

actions.name: Go to cell
actions.description: Make a cell the active cell, or move the active cell one step or to the start or end of its row or column, and remember it for later steps.

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

move.description: Move from the cell: one cell left, right, up or down, or to the first or last used cell of its row or column; none stays on it.

cell.description: Address of the cell that is now active.

options.label: A cell next to the active cell

actions.name: Go to next empty cell
actions.description: Starting from a cell, walk along its column or row to the first empty cell and make that cell the active cell.

start_cell.description: Where to start; the active cell when empty.

direction.description: down or up searches the column, right or left searches the row.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

cell.description: Address of the cell that is now active.

actions.name: Hide columns
actions.description: Hide one or more columns.

column.description: Column letter or 1-based number of the first column.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Hide rows
actions.description: Hide one or more rows.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Hide sheet
actions.description: Hide a worksheet chosen by name or position; at least one sheet must stay visible.

sheet.description: Sheet to hide.

index.description: 1-based sheet position, used instead of the name.

actions.name: Insert columns
actions.description: Insert empty columns before a column, moving the columns to the right.

column.description: Column letter or 1-based number the new columns go before.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Insert rows
actions.description: Insert empty rows before a row number, moving the rows below down.

row.description: 1-based row number the new rows go before.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Insert table column
actions.description: Add a named column to an Excel table, moving the table cells to its right over by one.

column_name.description: Header for the new column; ColumnN (the next free number) when empty.

position.description: 1-based position inside the table; at the end when empty.

actions.name: Open workbook
actions.description: Open an .xlsx or .xls workbook (a local path, onedrive:path or a pasted SharePoint or OneDrive link), or a .csv or .txt file (one sheet, saved back as text), or create a new one, as a named session; can open encrypted files, open read-only and skip hidden sheets.

session.description: Session name used by later steps.

create.description: Create the workbook when it does not exist.

sheet.description: Sheet to make active after opening; the sheet saved as active when empty.

read_only.description: Open for reading only: save over the opened file is refused, save_as to another file still works.

password.description: Password of an encrypted workbook; save keeps the file encrypted with the same password.

header.description: Whether sheets start with a row of column names; used by get_all_cells, get_range, filter and sort_range when their header input is empty.

access_token.description: For a path starting onedrive: (onedrive:Reports/sales.xlsx): a Microsoft Graph access token from the vault. The workbook is downloaded, and save and close with save upload it back.

drive.description: For onedrive: paths: me/drive (the signed-in user's OneDrive), sites/{site-id}/drive (a SharePoint library) or drives/{drive-id}.

edit_password.description: Password to modify the file (Excel's write access password); a wrong one stops the step. Without it such a file still opens.

skip_hidden_sheets.description: Leave hidden sheets out: sheet lists, counts and positions only see visible sheets, and later steps cannot use a hidden sheet.

sensitivity_label.description: Sensitivity label id (a GUID) to put on the workbook; it may come from the vault.

label_site_id.description: Microsoft 365 tenant id (a GUID) the label belongs to.

continue_if_label_fails.description: When the label cannot be set, log a warning and go on instead of stopping.

share.description: Agents this one runs may use it.

main.tick: The file has a password to edit
The file is on OneDrive or SharePoint

actions.name: Protect sheet
actions.description: Password-protect a worksheet so its locked cells cannot be edited in Excel, choosing which operations people may still perform.

password.description: Password needed to unprotect the sheet; a credential from the vault or text.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

allow_format_columns.description: People may change column widths and hide columns.

allow_format_rows.description: People may change row heights and hide rows.

allow_pivot_tables.description: People may use and change pivot tables.

allow_edit_objects.description: People may change pictures, charts and other objects.

actions.name: Protect workbook
actions.description: Require a password to open the file, lock the workbook structure and window layout with a password, or both.

password.description: Password needed to unlock the structure; a credential from the vault or text.

lock_structure.description: Stop sheets being added, removed, moved, renamed or unhidden.

lock_windows.description: Also fix the size and position of the workbook windows.

open_password.description: Encrypt the file with this password when it is saved, so it cannot be opened without it.

main.tick: Require a password to open the file
Lock the structure with a password

actions.name: Read column
actions.description: Read the values of one column, from the active cell or a start row down to an end row or the last used row.

column.description: Column letter, 1-based number or header name (looked up in header_row); empty starts at the active cell and reads down its column.

start_row.description: 1-based row to start from, e.g. 2 to skip a header.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

end_row.description: 1-based last row to read; the last used row when empty.

read_as.description: value returns numbers, dates and booleans as such; text returns what Excel displays, with number formats applied.

header_row.description: Row with the column names. A column given by name is looked up here (row 1 when empty), and reading starts below this row.

values.description: Cell values from top to bottom; empty cells are null.

actions.name: Read cell formula
actions.description: Return the formula a cell (or the active cell) holds, or an empty text when it holds a plain value.

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell (set by go_to_cell) when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

has_formula.description: True when the cell holds a formula.

actions.name: Read row
actions.description: Read the values of one row, from the active cell or a start column to an end column or the last used cell.

row.description: 1-based row number; empty starts at the active cell and reads along its row.

start_column.description: Column letter or 1-based number to start from.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

end_column.description: Column letter or 1-based number of the last column to read; the last used cell when empty.

read_as.description: value returns numbers, dates and booleans as such; text returns what Excel displays, with number formats applied.

values.description: Cell values from left to right; empty cells are null.

actions.name: Remove blank rows
actions.description: Delete every empty row inside the used area, or between two rows, and close the gaps.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

start_row.description: First row to check (1 = first row); the first row when empty.

end_row.description: Last row to check; the last row with data when empty.

actions.name: Remove duplicate rows
actions.description: Remove the rows of a range (or of the used area) that repeat an earlier row, comparing all columns or only the chosen ones, like Excel's Remove Duplicates; the first of each set is kept and the rows below move up inside the range.

range.description: Range to check; the used area when empty.

header.description: The first row is a header and is kept as it is; the workbook's open setting (true by default) when empty.

columns.description: Columns that make a row a duplicate: header names, letters or 1-based sheet column numbers; all columns of the range when empty.

match_case.description: Treat "ACME" and "acme" as different; Excel treats them as the same.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

remaining.description: Number of rows left in the range, the header row not counted.

actions.name: Rename worksheet
actions.description: Give a worksheet, chosen by name or position, a new name.

sheet.description: Current sheet name.

new_name.description: New sheet name.

index.description: 1-based sheet position, used instead of the name.

actions.name: Replace
actions.description: Replace text in the cells of a sheet or range, optionally matching case or the whole cell, inside formulas, or only in the first matching cell.

range.description: Limit to this range; whole sheet when empty.

whole_cell.description: Only replace when the whole cell equals the text.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

look_in.description: values changes text cells; formulas also changes the formula text of formula cells, e.g. a sheet name inside references.

search_by.description: Search order: rows goes across each row first, columns goes down each column first; matters with first_only.

first_only.description: Change only the first matching cell in search order.

start_from.description: G3 (AA parity): where the search starts: the top of the sheet, the active cell, a given cell (start_cell), or the end (searching backwards); it goes round to the start, as Excel does.

start_cell.description: The cell the search starts at.

cells.description: Addresses of the changed cells, in search order.

actions.name: Get number of rows
actions.description: Count the rows that hold data, or all rows of the used area, and report the number of the last used row.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

mode.description: non_empty counts rows holding data; all counts every row from the first to the last used row, empty ones included.

index.description: 1-based sheet position, used instead of the name.

count.description: Rows with at least one non-empty cell, or all rows of the used area.

last_row.description: 1-based number of the last row with data; 0 when the sheet is empty.

actions.name: Get row and column number
actions.description: Split a cell address such as B7, or the active cell, into its row and column numbers.

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

session.description: Workbook session; used for the active cell.

column.description: 1-based column number.

actions.name: Save
actions.description: Save the workbook, optionally to a new path (Save as); encrypted workbooks stay encrypted.

path.description: Save-as path; the opened file when empty.

password.description: Encrypt the saved file with this password; the password the workbook was opened with when empty.

actions.name: Save as
actions.description: Save the workbook to a new file as xlsx, xls or csv, optionally password-protected; after xlsx or xls the session continues on the new file.

format.description: File format; taken from the file extension when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet written for csv; active sheet when empty.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already exists at the target path; false stops with EXCEL.EXISTS.

password.description: Encrypt the new xlsx or xls file with this password; later saves keep it. Not used for csv.

actions.name: Select range
actions.description: Select a range, whole rows, whole columns (given, or those of the active cell) or the whole sheet; later steps see it as the current selection and its top-left cell becomes active.

range.description: Range address.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

select.description: What to select: a range, whole rows, whole columns, or every cell of the sheet.

rows.description: Row number or rows such as 3:5; the active cell's row when empty.

columns.description: Column letter, number or columns such as C:E; the active cell's column when empty.

range.description: The address that is now selected, e.g. A3:XFD5 for rows 3 to 5.

actions.name: Set cell
actions.description: Write a value to one cell, or to the active cell.

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell (set by go_to_cell) when empty.

value.description: Value to write; empty clears the cell.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Set cell colour
actions.description: Give a cell or range a solid fill colour or a font colour.

range.description: Cell or range to colour.

color.description: Hex colour (#FFC000), red,green,blue numbers (255,192,0) or a colour name such as yellow or light blue.

target.description: fill for the background, font for the text colour.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Set column width
actions.description: Set the width of one or more columns, in characters as Excel shows it.

column.description: Column letter or 1-based number of the first column.

width.description: Width in characters (Excel's default is 8.43); 0 hides the columns.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Set formula
actions.description: Put a formula in a cell, or in the active cell, e.g. SUM(C2:C10).

cell.description: Cell address; the active cell (set by go_to_cell) when empty.

formula.description: Formula, with or without a leading =.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Set row height
actions.description: Set the height of one or more rows, in points as Excel shows it.

height.description: Height in points (Excel's default is 15); 0 hides the rows.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Set sensitivity label
actions.description: Write a sensitivity label into the workbook's MSIP_Label custom properties, replacing any earlier label; this marks the file but does not encrypt it.

label_id.description: Label GUID from your organisation's compliance centre; it may come from the vault.

site_id.description: Tenant (site) GUID the label belongs to.

method.description: Standard for a default label, Privileged for one chosen by a person.

actions.name: Get sheet count
actions.description: Count the worksheets in the workbook, with or without the hidden ones.

actions.name: Sort
actions.description: Sort the rows of a range, an Excel table or the used area by one column and an optional second column, ascending or descending, keeping a header row in place; or sort only that column's cells.

column.description: Sort column: letter, 1-based sheet column number, or header name.

header.description: The first row is a header and stays at the top; the workbook's open setting (true by default) when empty.

range.description: Range to sort; the used area when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

then_by.description: Second sort column used when the first column's values are equal: letter, number or header name.

then_descending.description: Sort the second column from largest to smallest.

table.description: Excel table name, e.g. Table1: sort that table's rows (its header row stays); sheet and range are then not used.

only_column.description: Sort only the cells of the sort column and leave the other columns as they are (rows no longer stay together).

sort_as.description: auto keeps numbers before text as Excel does; number sorts numbers written as text by their value; text sorts everything as text.

actions.name: Switch to sheet
actions.description: Make a worksheet, chosen by name or position, the active one; later steps with an empty sheet input work on it.

sheet.description: Sheet name to activate.

index.description: 1-based sheet position, used instead of the name.

actions.name: Text to columns
actions.description: Split the text of a column into several columns at a delimiter, like Excel's Text to Columns; the parts overwrite the cells to the right.

column.description: Column holding the text: letter or 1-based number.

delimiter.description: Text between the parts: a character such as , ; | or the words tab or space. Parts inside double quotes are kept whole.

start_row.description: First row to split; the first used row when empty.

end_row.description: Last row to split; the last used row when empty.

destination.description: Column to write the first part to; the column itself when empty.

convert_numbers.description: Store parts that are plain numbers, such as 12.5, as numbers, as Excel does.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

columns.description: Most parts any cell was split into.

actions.name: Unhide all sheets
actions.description: Make every hidden worksheet visible.

count.description: Number of sheets that were hidden.

actions.name: Unhide columns
actions.description: Show hidden columns again.

column.description: Column letter or 1-based number of the first column.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Unhide rows
actions.description: Show hidden rows again.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

actions.name: Unhide sheet
actions.description: Make a hidden worksheet, chosen by name or position, visible again.

sheet.description: Sheet to show.

index.description: 1-based sheet position, used instead of the name.

actions.name: Unprotect sheet
actions.description: Remove protection from a worksheet; for .xlsx files the password is checked first.

password.description: Sheet password; a credential from the vault or text.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

was_protected.description: False when the sheet was not protected (nothing to do).

actions.name: Unprotect workbook
actions.description: Stop asking for a password to open the file, unlock a protected workbook structure and windows (the password must match), or both.

password.description: Structure password; a credential from the vault or text.

remove_open_password.description: Save the file without encryption from now on, so it opens without a password.

actions.name: Write from Data Table
actions.description: Write a table (with column names) starting at a cell.

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

iterators.name: Each row in a worksheet
iterators.description: Yield each row of a sheet (or of a range) of an open workbook as a record keyed by the header names (Column1, Column2 ... without a header).

sheet.description: Sheet name; active sheet when empty.

range.description: Only this range, e.g. A1:D50; the used area when empty.

header.description: First row holds column names; the workbook's open setting (true by default) when empty.

read_as.description: value returns numbers, dates and booleans as such; text returns what Excel displays, with number formats applied.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden rows; false skips rows hidden by a filter.

from_row.description: Only from this sheet row number on (the header row, when there is one, still gives the column names); from the first row when empty.

to_row.description: Only up to this sheet row number, included; to the last used row when empty.

name: Excel desktop
description: Run macros, refresh data and pivots, update links, export to PDF and convert workbooks using the installed Microsoft Excel.

actions.name: Convert workbook
actions.description: Save a workbook in another format, e.g. .xls to .xlsx or .csv to .xlsx, optionally with a password on the new file.

target.description: Target file; the format follows its extension (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xlsb, .xls, .csv, .txt, .ods, .xltx, .xltm).

overwrite.description: Replace the target when it already exists; false stops with EXCEL_DESKTOP.EXISTS.

password.description: Password needed to open the workbook; passed to Excel through the environment, not the command line.

new_password.description: Password needed to open the converted file; none when empty.

main.tick: Protect the new file with a password

actions.name: Export to PDF
actions.description: Export the whole workbook, the active sheet or one sheet to PDF (from a file, or a workbook open in an Excel session, unsaved changes included), choosing quality, page range, print areas and document properties.

path.description: Workbook; not needed when a session is given.

target.description: PDF file to create.

sheet.description: Only this sheet; the whole workbook when empty.

quality.description: standard for printing; minimum for a smaller file to publish online.

include_properties.description: Copy the workbook's title, author and other properties into the PDF.

ignore_print_areas.description: Export whole sheets even where a print area is set.

from_page.description: First printed page to export; from the first page when empty.

to_page.description: Last printed page to export; to the last page when empty.

overwrite.description: Replace the PDF when it already exists; false stops with EXCEL_DESKTOP.EXISTS.

password.description: Password needed to open the workbook; passed to Excel through the environment, not the command line.

session.description: An Excel session open in this run: the step works on that workbook as it is now, changes not yet saved included; the path is not needed then (G3).

if_exists.description: When the PDF is already there: replace it, stop the step, or add a number such as (2) to the name (G3); follows overwrite when empty.

path.description: The PDF file written (with a number added when one was already there).

actions.name: Refresh all data
actions.description: Refresh every query, connection and pivot table in the workbook, wait for completion, recalculate and save unless told not to.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time.

password.description: Password needed to open the workbook; passed to Excel through the environment, not the command line.

actions.name: Run macro
actions.description: Run a VBA macro, with up to 10 arguments, in a macro-enabled workbook (a file, or a workbook open in an Excel session, unsaved changes included) and optionally save.

path.description: Workbook (.xlsm/.xlsb/.xls); not needed when a session is given.

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the macro (text).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum run time.

password.description: Password needed to open the workbook; passed to Excel through the environment, not the command line.

visible.description: Show the Excel window while the agent works, e.g. to watch a macro; hidden by default.

session.description: An Excel session open in this run: the step works on that workbook as it is now, changes not yet saved included; the path is not needed then (G3).

result.description: Value returned by the macro (for Functions), as text.

actions.name: Update workbook links
actions.description: Open the workbook in Excel, refresh the values taken from every linked workbook and save.

password.description: Password needed to open the workbook; passed to Excel through the environment, not the command line.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time.

name: Exchange (EWS)
description: Read, send, reply to, move, mark and delete emails in an on-premises Exchange Server 2013-2019 or SE mailbox through Exchange Web Services (EWS). For Exchange Online (Microsoft 365) use the Microsoft 365 toolkit, as Microsoft is retiring EWS there.

actions.name: Connect to Exchange mailbox
actions.description: Sign in to an on-premises Exchange Server mailbox through Exchange Web Services (EWS) as a named session; checks the sign-in by opening the inbox. For Exchange Online (Microsoft 365) use the Microsoft 365 toolkit instead: Microsoft is retiring EWS there.

ews_url.description: Address of the Exchange server's web services, usually https://<mail server>/EWS/Exchange.asmx.

user.description: User that signs in: DOMAIN\user or user@domain (or the user alone with domain).

password.description: The user's password from the vault (a Credential).

sign_in.description: ntlm: Windows sign-in, which Exchange accepts by default; basic: user name and password in each request, only over https and where the server allows it; oauth: an access token from a saved sign-in connection or the vault (hybrid modern authentication) (G5).

mailbox.description: Work in this mailbox instead of the user's own, e.g. a shared mailbox; the user needs full access to it, or the impersonation role with impersonate.

impersonate.description: Act as the mailbox's owner through Exchange impersonation (the user needs the ApplicationImpersonation role) instead of opening it as a delegate.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for each answer from the server.

insecure_tls.description: Accept any server certificate (self-signed or expired); for test systems only.

domain.description: Windows domain, when user has none (G5).

version.description: The Exchange version the requests are written for (G5).

access_token.description: OAuth access token for the Exchange server, from a saved sign-in connection or the vault (G5).

main.tick: Open another person's or a shared mailbox

actions.name: Delete email
actions.description: Delete an email: moved to Deleted Items, or with permanent removed from the folders (Exchange still keeps it in Recoverable Items for its retention time).

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

permanent.description: Remove the email instead of moving it to Deleted Items; only an administrator can bring it back.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

actions.name: Delete all emails
actions.description: Delete every email of a folder that the filters find (G5).

folder.description: Folder: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, deleteditems, drafts, junkemail, archive), a path such as Inbox/Invoices, or a folder id.

status.description: Which emails: any, only unread or only read.

from_contains.description: Sender contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

subject_contains.description: Subject contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

since.description: Received on or after this time (UTC).

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

permanent.description: Remove them instead of moving them to Deleted Items.

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the Exchange mailbox session.

actions.name: Forward email
actions.description: Forward an email, with its attachments, and a note shown above the original.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

note.description: Text shown above the forwarded email.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

attachments.description: Files to attach (paths); the reply is then saved as a draft, given the files and sent.

as_attachment.description: Attach the original email as an .eml file instead of quoting it below the note.

actions.name: Read email
actions.description: Read one email: sender, recipients, subject, text, HTML and attachment names.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

email.description: id, from, to, cc, subject, received, text, html, attachments, reply_to, sent, message_id, importance, flagged, size, unread, conversation_id. Also, the same on every mail service: id, from, to, cc, subject, received, text, html, attachments (names), has_attachments, unread, message_id.

actions.name: Get folders
actions.description: List all mail folders of the mailbox as paths such as Inbox/Invoices.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

actions.name: Find emails
actions.description: List emails in an Exchange folder, newest first, filtered by unread, sender, subject and date; loop over the table to process them.

folder.description: Folder: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, deleteditems, drafts, junkemail, archive), a path such as Inbox/Invoices, or a folder id.

from_contains.description: Sender contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

subject_contains.description: Subject contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

since.description: Received on or after this time (UTC).

oldest_first.description: Return the oldest emails first instead of the newest.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

body_contains.description: Body contains this text (searched by the server); separate several with ; to match any of them.

table.description: Columns: id, from, subject, received, unread, has_attachments.

actions.name: Mark read or unread
actions.description: Mark an email as read or unread, and optionally set or clear its follow-up flag.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

flagged.description: Set (true) or clear (false) the follow-up flag; unchanged when empty.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

status.description: Mark it read or unread (G5); the tick below for older steps.

actions.name: Move email
actions.description: Move an email to another folder, e.g. Inbox/Processed; returns its new id, as Exchange gives a moved email a new one.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

to_folder.description: Destination: a well-known name such as archive, a path such as Inbox/Processed, or a folder id.

create_folder.description: Create the destination folder (and the folders on its path) when it does not exist.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

new_id.description: The email's id in the destination folder.

actions.name: Move all emails
actions.description: Move every email of a folder that the filters find to another folder (G5).

folder.description: Folder: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, deleteditems, drafts, junkemail, archive), a path such as Inbox/Invoices, or a folder id.

status.description: Which emails: any, only unread or only read.

from_contains.description: Sender contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

subject_contains.description: Subject contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

since.description: Received on or after this time (UTC).

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

to_folder.description: Destination: a well-known name, a path such as Inbox/Processed, or a folder id.

create_folder.description: Create the destination when it does not exist.

actions.name: Reply to email
actions.description: Reply to the sender of an email, keeping it in the same conversation with the original quoted below.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

body.description: Reply text, shown above the original.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

attachments.description: Files to attach (paths); the reply is then saved as a draft, given the files and sent.

actions.name: Reply to all
actions.description: Reply to the sender and all other recipients of an email, keeping it in the same conversation with the original quoted below.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

body.description: Reply text, shown above the original.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

attachments.description: Files to attach (paths); the reply is then saved as a draft, given the files and sent.

exclude_sender.description: Leave the original sender out, replying only to the other recipients (e.g. to tell the team, not the customer).

actions.name: Save all attachments
actions.description: Save the attachments of every email of a folder that the filters find (G5).

folder.description: Folder: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, deleteditems, drafts, junkemail, archive), a path such as Inbox/Invoices, or a folder id.

status.description: Which emails: any, only unread or only read.

from_contains.description: Sender contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

subject_contains.description: Subject contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

since.description: Received on or after this time (UTC).

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

name_pattern.description: Only names matching this pattern, e.g. *.pdf.

overwrite.description: Replace files of the same name instead of adding a number.

actions.name: Save attachments
actions.description: Save an email's file attachments to a folder, optionally only names matching a pattern such as *.pdf.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

name_pattern.description: Only names matching this pattern, e.g. *.pdf.

overwrite.description: Replace files of the same name instead of adding a number such as (2).

include_inline.description: Also save images embedded in the body, such as signature logos.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

actions.name: Save email as .eml
actions.description: Save a whole email (text, HTML, attachments and headers) as an .eml file that any mail program opens.

id.description: Email id from Find emails (an EWS item id).

local_path.description: The .eml file to write, or a folder: the subject then names the file.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that is already there; when false it stops the step.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

actions.name: Send email
actions.description: Send an email (plain text or HTML) with optional CC, BCC and attachments from the Exchange mailbox, keeping a copy in Sent Items.

to.description: Recipient address(es); separate several with ; or give a list.

from.description: Send as this address, e.g. a shared mailbox; the user needs Send As or Send on Behalf rights. The session's mailbox when empty.

reply_to.description: Address(es) that replies go to, when not the sender.

read_receipt.description: Ask for a receipt when the email is read.

save_to_sent_items.description: Keep a copy in Sent Items.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

actions.name: Test Exchange connection
actions.description: Check an Exchange address and sign-in without keeping a session: ok and what went wrong (G5).

ews_url.description: Address of the Exchange server's web services.

user.description: User that signs in.

password.description: The user's password from the vault.

domain.description: Windows domain, when user has none.

access_token.description: OAuth access token.

insecure_tls.description: Accept any server certificate; for test systems only.

ok.description: True when the sign-in worked and the inbox opened.

message.description: What went wrong, or empty.

conditions.name: Exchange folder exists
conditions.description: True when the mailbox has the folder, e.g. Inbox/Invoices (G5).

folder.description: Folder: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, deleteditems, drafts, junkemail, archive), a path such as Inbox/Invoices, or a folder id.

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

iterators.name: Each email in an Exchange folder
iterators.description: Yield each email matching the Find emails filters as a dictionary: id, from, subject, received, unread, has_attachments.

folder.description: Folder: a well-known name (inbox, sentitems, deleteditems, drafts, junkemail, archive), a path such as Inbox/Invoices, or a folder id.

from_contains.description: Sender contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

subject_contains.description: Subject contains this text; separate several with ; to match any of them.

since.description: Received on or after this time (UTC).

session.description: Session name of the open Exchange mailbox.

oldest_first.description: The oldest emails first instead of the newest.

body_contains.description: Body contains this text (searched by the server); separate several with ; to match any of them.
