name: File
description: Read, write, copy, move and delete files.

actions.name: Copy
actions.description: Copy a file, every file the name rules choose, or every file of a folder that matches a pattern and optional size and date limits, replacing or keeping existing targets.

source.description: Source file, name rules choosing several files, or a folder when pattern is given.

target.description: Target file, or a folder when several files are copied.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing target.

keep_both.description: When the target exists and overwrite is false, use a free name such as report (2).pdf instead of stopping.

pattern.description: Copy every file in the source folder whose name matches this glob pattern; the target is then a folder. A source such as in/*.pdf works too.

include_subfolders.description: With a pattern, also take matching files in sub-folders, keeping their folders under the target.

min_size_bytes.description: With a pattern, only files at least this large.

max_size_bytes.description: With a pattern, only files at most this large.

modified_after.description: With a pattern, only files last changed after this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

modified_before.description: With a pattern, only files last changed before this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

parallel.description: Copy up to four files at the same time; faster for many files on a network share.

path.description: Path of the copy (the target folder when copying several files).

main.tick: Copy several files by name pattern

actions.name: Create file
actions.description: Create an empty file (or one holding some text), choosing what happens when a file of that name is already there.

new_file.description: File to create; its folder is created when missing.

if_exists.description: When the file is already there: stop with FILE.EXISTS, replace it, create a numbered name such as notes (2).txt, or leave it as it is.

text.description: Text to put in the new file; empty for an empty file.

encoding.description: Text encoding, e.g. utf-8, utf-16le, windows-1252.

path.description: Full path of the file (the numbered name with keep both).

created.description: True when a file was written; false when an existing file was kept.

actions.name: Create shortcut
actions.description: Create a shortcut that opens a file: a .lnk file on Windows, a .desktop file or symbolic link elsewhere.

shortcut.description: Shortcut to create; .lnk is added on Windows when missing.

arguments.description: Command-line arguments passed when the shortcut is opened.

comment.description: Tooltip text shown for the shortcut.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing shortcut.

actions.name: Create symbolic link
actions.description: Create a symbolic link that points to a file; on Windows this needs Developer Mode or administrator rights.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file link (never a real folder).

actions.name: Create temporary file
actions.description: Create an empty file with a unique name in the temporary folder (or another folder), for working data an agent needs only for a while.

delete_at_end.description: Delete the file when the run ends (also when it fails); turn off to keep it.

folder.description: Folder to create it in; the system's temporary folder when empty.

path.description: Full path of the new file.

actions.name: Delete
actions.description: Delete a file if it exists, every file the name rules choose, or every file in a folder that matches a pattern and optional size and age limits.

path.description: File path (or name rules choosing several files), or a folder when pattern is given.

pattern.description: Delete the files in the folder at path that match this glob pattern.

include_subfolders.description: With pattern, also delete matching files in sub-folders.

older_than_days.description: With pattern, only files last changed more than this many days ago.

min_size_bytes.description: With pattern, only files at least this large.

max_size_bytes.description: With pattern, only files at most this large.

modified_after.description: With pattern, only files last changed after this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

modified_before.description: With pattern, only files last changed before this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

parallel.description: Delete up to four files at the same time; faster for many files on a network share.

main.tick: Delete several files by name pattern

actions.name: Base64 to file
actions.description: Write Base64 text (for example a PDF or image returned by a web service) to a file.

base64.description: Base64 text; a data: prefix such as data:application/pdf;base64, is allowed.

path.description: File to write; its folder is created when missing.

overwrite.description: Replace the file when it exists; when off, stop with FILE.EXISTS.

path.description: Full path of the written file.

actions.name: Get file from One CommandCenter
actions.description: Copy a file kept in One CommandCenter (its Agents page, Files) to the runner, by its path there; the path may come from a variable.

repository_path.description: The file's path in One CommandCenter, e.g. Templates/invoice.xlsx or $template$.

save_to.description: File or folder on the runner; the run's temporary folder when empty (the path is returned).

overwrite.description: Replace a file already there; when off, an existing file stops the step.

path.description: Where the file was saved on the runner.

actions.name: Get file info
actions.description: Return a file's name, extension, folder, size and last modified time.

info.description: name, extension, folder, size_bytes, modified, exists.

actions.name: Get file name
actions.description: Return the last part of a path, with and without its extension; the file does not need to exist.

name_without_extension.description: Name without the last extension, e.g. report.

extension.description: Extension without the dot, e.g. pdf; empty when there is none.

actions.name: Get parent folder
actions.description: Return the folder that contains a file or folder, as a full path.

folder.description: Parent folder, or empty for a drive or root.

actions.name: List files
actions.description: List the files in a folder that match a pattern, or the files the name rules choose.

folder.description: Folder path, or name rules (a folder and rules on name, type, size and date) choosing the files.

pattern.description: Glob pattern, e.g. *.pdf.

include_subfolders.description: Also list matching files in sub-folders.

min_size_bytes.description: Only files at least this large.

max_size_bytes.description: Only files at most this large.

modified_within_days.description: Only files changed in the last this many days.

older_than_days.description: Only files last changed more than this many days ago.

sort_by.description: Order of the list: by path name, by last change (oldest first) or by size (smallest first).

descending.description: Reverse the order, e.g. newest first with sort_by modified.

files.description: File paths in the chosen order.

first.description: First file of the list (e.g. the newest with sort_by modified, descending); empty when none.

actions.name: Move or rename
actions.description: Move or rename a file, or move every file the name rules choose or every file of a folder that matches a pattern and optional size and date limits, replacing or keeping existing targets.

source.description: Source file, name rules choosing several files, or a folder when pattern is given.

target.description: New path or name, or a folder when several files are moved.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing target.

keep_both.description: When the target exists and overwrite is false, use a free name such as report (2).pdf instead of stopping.

pattern.description: Move every file in the source folder whose name matches this glob pattern; the target is then a folder. A source such as in/*.pdf works too.

include_subfolders.description: With a pattern, also take matching files in sub-folders, keeping their folders under the target.

min_size_bytes.description: With a pattern, only files at least this large.

max_size_bytes.description: With a pattern, only files at most this large.

modified_after.description: With a pattern, only files last changed after this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

modified_before.description: With a pattern, only files last changed before this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

parallel.description: Move up to four files at the same time; faster for many files on a network share.

path.description: New path of the file (the target folder when moving several files).

more.tick: Move several files by name pattern

actions.name: Print files
actions.description: Print several files, in order, on a named printer or with each file's default application.

files.description: File paths to print (or use folder).

printer.description: Printer name; the default printer when empty.

folder.description: Print the files in this folder that match pattern (or the files name rules choose), after any files in the list.

pattern.description: With folder, glob pattern of the files to print.

include_subfolders.description: With folder, also print matching files in sub-folders.

modified_within_days.description: With folder, only files changed in the last this many days.

printed.description: Number of files sent to the printer.

actions.name: Read text
actions.description: Read a text file.

encoding.description: Text encoding, e.g. utf-8, utf-16le, windows-1252; auto reads a byte order mark, else takes UTF-8 when it fits, else windows-1252.

trim.description: Remove spaces and line breaks at the start, the end or both ends of the text.

actions.name: Read variables from file
actions.description: Read name=value lines (a settings or .properties-style file) into a Dictionary; blank lines and lines starting with # or ; are skipped.

path.description: Text file with one name=value per line.

separator.description: Text between the name and the value, e.g. = or : or a tab (\t).

encoding.description: Text encoding: utf-8, ansi, unicode ...

trim.description: Remove spaces around names and values.

trim_side.description: Which spaces trim removes: on both sides, only before, or only after the name and the value.

lowercase_keys.description: Turn names into lower case, so Server and server are the same variable.

values.description: Name to value, in file order.

actions.name: Rename file
actions.description: Give a file a new name in the same folder.

new_name.description: New name only, with its extension and without any folder.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already has the new name.

path.description: New full path of the file.

actions.name: File to Base64
actions.description: Read a file (a PDF, an image, any file) as Base64 text, for web services that take attachments as text.

path.description: File to read; up to 50 MB.

base64.description: The file's contents as Base64 text.

actions.name: Unzip
actions.description: Extract a .zip archive into a folder, also a password-protected one (AES or the older ZipCrypto); entries that would escape the folder are rejected.

folder.description: Destination folder.

overwrite.description: Replace files that already exist; when false they are kept and skipped.

password.description: Password of a protected archive, from the vault.

actions.name: Wait for file
actions.description: Wait until a file appears and has stopped growing (for example a download or an export), then return its path.

path.description: File to wait for; the name may use * and ? (e.g. Downloads/report*.xlsx), the newest match wins.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait at most.

stable_seconds.description: The file's size must stay the same for this long, so a file still being written is not taken.

ignore_temporary.description: Skip browser download placeholders (.crdownload, .part, .tmp) and Office lock files (~$...).

fail_on_timeout.description: Fail with FILE.WAIT_TIMEOUT when time runs out; otherwise found is false.

path.description: Path of the file found; empty when time ran out and fail_on_timeout is off.

found.description: True when the file was found in time.

actions.name: Write text
actions.description: Write text to a file, overwriting or appending.

encoding.description: Text encoding, e.g. utf-8, utf-16le, windows-1252; ansi uses the runner's default.

fail_if_exists.description: Stop instead of writing when the file already exists.

actions.name: Zip
actions.description: Compress files or a folder into a .zip archive, or add them to an existing one, optionally protected with a password (AES-256, opened by 7-Zip, WinZip and most tools).

source.description: File or folder to compress, or name rules choosing the files.

target.description: Archive path, e.g. out/report.zip.

pattern.description: Only add files whose names match this glob pattern; all files when empty.

compression.description: normal: default size and speed; fast and fastest trade size for speed; store adds files uncompressed.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing archive; when false an existing archive stops the step.

delete_originals.description: Delete the files that were added once the archive is complete.

password.description: Encrypt every file with this password (AES-256). Windows Explorer cannot open such archives; 7-Zip, WinZip and most tools can.

add_to_existing.description: When the archive already exists, keep what is in it and add the files (overwrite is then ignored); a file whose name is already in it replaces that entry. Not with a password.

only_newer.description: When adding to an existing archive, replace an entry only when the file is newer than it (by more than 2 seconds, the precision of zip dates); new names are always added.

added.description: Number of files written into the archive (new or replaced).

conditions.name: File date is
conditions.description: Compare when a file was last changed or created with a date or a range, or check its age in days, hours, minutes or seconds.

operator.description: Before, after or on a date (calendar day, UTC), between two dates, or older/newer than an age.

date.description: Date to compare with (UTC); the start of the range for between.

days.description: Age in the chosen unit (days when no unit is chosen).

until.description: End of the range for between (UTC).

inclusive.description: Count a file dated exactly on the date (or on either end of the range) as matching.

conditions.name: File exists
conditions.description: True when the file exists.

conditions.name: File has extension
conditions.description: True when the file name ends with one of the extensions, e.g. pdf, xlsx (case is ignored).

extensions.description: One or more extensions separated by commas, with or without the dot, or a List variable of them.

conditions.name: File size is
conditions.description: Compare the size of a file with a number of bytes, KB or MB, e.g. larger than 0 bytes.

unit.description: Unit of the size (1 KB = 1024 bytes).

iterators.name: Each file in folder
iterators.description: Yield each file in a folder (or each file the name rules choose): its path, or with details its name, extension, folder, size and date.

folder.description: Folder path, or name rules choosing the files.

pattern.description: Glob pattern.

details.description: Give each file as a Dictionary with path, name, name_without_extension, extension, folder, size_bytes and modified, instead of its path alone.
details.x-ooa-label: Each pass gives the file's details

name: FTP / SFTP
description: Connect to FTP, FTPS or SFTP servers to list, upload, download, rename and delete files.

actions.name: Change folder
actions.description: Change the session's current remote folder; later relative paths start from it.

folder.description: Remote folder, absolute or relative to the current one.

to_parent.description: Go up to the parent folder (G5).

folder.description: Current remote folder after the change.

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Connect and sign in to an FTP, FTPS or SFTP server, optionally trying again when the server cannot be reached and starting in a chosen folder.

protocol.description: sftp (SSH), ftps (FTP over TLS) or plain ftp.

port.description: Port; 22 for SFTP, 21 for FTP/FTPS when empty.

user.description: User name; it may come from the vault.

password.description: Password from the vault.

private_key.description: SFTP private key file (instead of a password).

host_key_fingerprint.description: Expected SFTP server fingerprint (SHA256:...); strongly recommended.

passive_mode.description: FTP/FTPS: the client opens the data connections (works through most firewalls); false uses active mode.

implicit_tls.description: FTPS: use implicit TLS (usually port 990) instead of explicit TLS after connecting.

transfer_mode.description: FTP/FTPS: binary copies files byte for byte; ascii converts line endings of text files.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait when connecting and for each server reply.

retry_attempts.description: How many more times to try when the server cannot be reached or drops the connection; 0 tries once. A wrong password or server fingerprint is never retried.

start_folder.description: Remote folder to change to right after signing in; later relative paths start from it.

anonymous.description: Sign in as anonymous, for public FTP servers (G5).

ftps_encryption.description: FTPS: explicit (TLS after connecting, usually port 21) or implicit (TLS from the start, usually 990); overrides implicit_tls (G5).

actions.name: Create folder
actions.description: Create a remote folder, and the folders on its path that are missing (e.g. /in/2026/11).

folder.description: Remote folder.

actions.name: Delete
actions.description: Delete a remote file.

remote_path.description: Remote file.

actions.name: Delete files
actions.description: Delete the files in a remote folder whose names match a wildcard such as *.tmp.

folder.description: Remote folder.

pattern.description: Wildcard of the files to delete (* and ?); * deletes every file.

deleted.description: Remote paths of the deleted files.

actions.name: Delete folder
actions.description: Delete a remote folder; a folder with contents is deleted only when recursive is true.

folder.description: Remote folder to delete.

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the connection.

actions.name: Download
actions.description: Download a remote file.

remote_path.description: Remote file.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing local file; when false an existing file stops the step.

actions.name: Get files
actions.description: Download every file of a remote folder whose name matches a pattern, optionally only those changed in a date range (G5).

folder.description: Remote folder.

pattern.description: Only names matching this wildcard (* and ?).

local_folder.description: Folder on the runner to save into.

overwrite.description: Replace local files of the same name; off skips them.

modified_after.description: Only files changed on or after this time (UTC).

modified_before.description: Only files changed before this time (UTC).

transfer_mode.description: FTP/FTPS: binary or ascii for these files; the session's when empty.

actions.name: Download folder
actions.description: Download a remote folder with all its files and sub-folders into a local folder; optionally only files changed in the last days or between two dates.

local_folder.description: Local folder that receives the contents.

pattern.description: Only files whose names match this wildcard (* and ?).

include_subfolders.description: Also copy sub-folders and their files.

overwrite.description: Replace files that already exist; when false they are skipped.

only_newer.description: Copy a file only when it is newer than the existing copy (by modified time).

modified_within_days.description: Only files the server reports as changed in this many days up to now (0 = today, from midnight UTC).

modified_after.description: Only files changed at or after this time (UTC).

modified_before.description: Only files changed before this time (UTC).

files.description: Local paths of the downloaded files.

actions.name: List files
actions.description: List a remote folder.

folder.description: Remote folder.

pattern.description: Only names matching this wildcard (* and ?).

modified_after.description: Only items changed on or after this time (UTC) (G5).

modified_before.description: Only items changed before this time (UTC) (G5).

actions.name: Rename or move
actions.description: Rename or move a remote file.

actions.name: Send FTP command
actions.description: Send one raw command, such as SITE CHMOD 644 file.txt, FEAT or SYST, to an FTP or FTPS server and return its reply. SFTP sessions do not take raw commands.

command.description: The command and its arguments. Commands that sign in, change security or the data channel, or close the connection are refused.

reply_code.description: The server's three-digit reply code, such as 200 or 550.

ok.description: True when the reply code is 2xx or 3xx.

actions.name: Synchronise folders
actions.description: Make a local and a remote folder match: copy new and changed files one way or both ways, optionally delete files that are no longer on the source side, or only report what would change.

direction.description: upload makes the remote folder match the local one, download the other way round; both copies each side's new and newer files to the other.

pattern.description: Only files whose names match this wildcard (* and ?); other files are neither copied nor deleted.

include_subfolders.description: Also synchronise sub-folders and their files.

compare.description: When a file is on both sides, copy it when the source is newer (newer), when the sizes differ (size), or either (both). Times within 2 seconds count as the same; on FTP servers that only give times to the minute, within a minute.

delete_extra.description: Delete files on the target side that are not on the source side; folders are left in place. Not allowed when direction is both.

dry_run.description: Only report what would be copied and deleted; change nothing.

uploaded.description: Files copied to the server (or that would be, in a dry run).

deleted.description: Files deleted on the target side.

skipped.description: Source files left alone because the target copy is the same, or, in both directions, because neither copy is newer.

details.description: One entry per file: {path, action}; path is relative to the folders, action is upload, download, delete_remote, delete_local, skip or conflict.

actions.name: Upload
actions.description: Upload a local file.

remote_path.description: Remote path including the file name.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing remote file; when false an existing file stops the step.

actions.name: Put files
actions.description: Upload several local files, or those matching a pattern in a local folder, into a remote folder (G5).

local_folder.description: A local folder whose matching files are uploaded.

pattern.description: With local_folder: only names matching this wildcard.

overwrite.description: Replace remote files of the same name; off skips them.

transfer_mode.description: FTP/FTPS: binary or ascii for these files; the session's when empty.

actions.name: Upload folder
actions.description: Upload a local folder with all its files and sub-folders, creating remote folders as needed.

remote_folder.description: Remote folder that receives the contents.

pattern.description: Only files whose names match this wildcard (* and ?).

include_subfolders.description: Also copy sub-folders and their files.

overwrite.description: Replace files that already exist; when false they are skipped.

only_newer.description: Copy a file only when it is newer than the existing copy (by modified time).

files.description: Remote paths of the uploaded files.

name: Folder
description: Create, list, copy and delete folders.

actions.name: Copy folder
actions.description: Copy a folder and its contents, optionally only some files by name, size or date.

source.description: Source folder, or name rules choosing the files to copy (with the folders below the one they share).

target.description: Target folder.

overwrite.description: Replace files that already exist in the target; when false they are kept.

pattern.description: Only copy files whose names match this glob pattern; all files when empty.

only_newer.description: Copy a file only when it is newer than the one already in the target.

larger_than_kb.description: Only copy files larger than this many KB (1 KB = 1024 bytes).

smaller_than_kb.description: Only copy files smaller than this many KB.

modified_after.description: Only copy files last changed after this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

modified_before.description: Only copy files last changed before this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

actions.name: Create folder
actions.description: Create a folder and any missing parents, choosing what happens when it is already there.

fail_if_exists.description: Stop when the folder already exists instead of continuing (used when no choice is made for an existing folder).

if_exists.description: When the folder is already there: use it, replace it with an empty one (deleting what is in it), make a numbered one such as Reports (2), or stop with FOLDER.EXISTS.

path.description: Full path of the folder (the numbered name with numbered).

created.description: True when a folder was made; false when the existing one is used.

actions.name: Create folder shortcut
actions.description: Create a shortcut that opens a folder: a .lnk file on Windows, a .desktop file or symbolic link elsewhere.

shortcut.description: Shortcut to create; .lnk is added on Windows when missing.

comment.description: Tooltip text shown for the shortcut.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing shortcut.

actions.name: Create folder symbolic link
actions.description: Create a symbolic link that points to a folder; on Windows this needs Developer Mode or administrator rights.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing link (never a real folder).

actions.name: Delete folder
actions.description: Delete a folder, optionally only when its total size or its last-change date meets limits. Non-empty folders are deleted only when recursive is true.

larger_than_kb.description: Only when the folder holds more than this many KB in all its files, at any depth (1 KB = 1024 bytes).

smaller_than_kb.description: Only when the folder holds less than this many KB in all its files, at any depth.

modified_after.description: Only when the folder itself was last changed after this date and time (local time); adding or removing an item directly inside changes it.

modified_before.description: Only when the folder itself was last changed before this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

deleted.description: True when the folder was deleted; false when it did not exist or did not meet the limits.

actions.name: List subfolders
actions.description: List the folders directly inside a folder.

actions.name: Move folder
actions.description: Move a folder with everything in it into another folder, also to another drive.

destination.description: Folder to move it into; created when missing.

overwrite.description: When the destination already has a folder of the same name, merge into it and replace files of the same name; when off, stop with FOLDER.EXISTS.

path.description: New full path of the folder.

actions.name: Open folder
actions.description: Show a folder in the file manager (File Explorer on Windows).

actions.name: Rename folder
actions.description: Give a folder a new name in the same parent folder, optionally only when its total size or its last-change date meets limits.

new_name.description: New name only, without any path.

larger_than_kb.description: Only when the folder holds more than this many KB in all its files, at any depth (1 KB = 1024 bytes).

smaller_than_kb.description: Only when the folder holds less than this many KB in all its files, at any depth.

modified_after.description: Only when the folder itself was last changed after this date and time (local time); adding or removing an item directly inside changes it.

modified_before.description: Only when the folder itself was last changed before this date and time (UTC, like every DateTime; Text to date converts local times).

path.description: New full path of the folder; the unchanged path when it did not meet the limits.

renamed.description: True when the folder was renamed; false when it did not meet the limits.

actions.name: Get special folder
actions.description: Return the path of a standard folder of the signed-in user or of Windows, such as Desktop, Documents, Downloads or Temp, also when the user moved it (for example to OneDrive).

folder.description: Which folder; appdata is the roaming AppData folder, local_appdata is AppData\Local.

exists.description: True when the folder exists on this computer.

conditions.name: Folder exists
conditions.description: True when the folder exists.

conditions.name: Folder is empty
conditions.description: True when the folder exists and contains nothing.

iterators.name: Each folder in folder
iterators.description: Yield the path of each folder inside a folder, optionally with all folders below it.

include_subfolders.description: Also yield folders inside the sub-folders, at any depth.

pattern.description: Glob pattern for the folder names, e.g. 2026-*.

name: Interactive forms
description: Show a form to the person at the runner, react to its buttons and changes, and read or change its fields while it is open.

actions.name: Assign options
actions.description: Fill a drop-down or choice list with options, e.g. from a list or a data table column.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Id of a drop-down or choice field.

options.description: The options to offer, in order: a list, or text with the options separated by commas (G1).

select.description: Option to select; the current choice is kept when it is still offered.

mode.description: replace: offer only these options. append: add them after the options already offered, skipping ones already there.

actions.name: Change label
actions.description: Change the label of a field or the text of a button or heading.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

label.description: The new label.

actions.name: Change form title
actions.description: Change the title shown on the form window.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

title.description: The new title.

actions.name: Close form
actions.description: Close the open form window.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

values.description: The last answers by field id.

actions.name: Disable element
actions.description: Grey out a field or button so it cannot be used (a disabled field is not checked).

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

actions.name: Display form
actions.description: Show a form from the form designer to the person at the runner. Wait until they submit it, press a button or close it; or keep it open and go on, reacting to it with Wait for form event.

form.description: The form (.form.json) made in OneAgentStudio's form designer.

name.description: Name to refer to the open form by; the form's id when empty.

title.description: Window title; the form's name when empty.

values.description: Values to fill in first, by field id (the designer's defaults otherwise).

wait.description: until_done: wait until the form is submitted, a button is pressed or it is closed. no: keep it open and go on.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the person.

check_answers.description: Check required fields and limits in the window before it can be submitted.

always_on_top.description: Keep the form window above other windows while it is open (Windows).

values.description: The answers by field id (numbers as Number, checkboxes as true/false).

button.description: How the wait ended: submit, the id of the button pressed, closed, or timeout. Empty when not waiting.

submitted.description: True when the person submitted the form.

name.description: Name of the open form, for the other form actions.

address.description: Local address of the form window (this computer only).

actions.name: Set dynamic area
actions.description: Replace what a dynamic area on the form shows with new fields, e.g. one line per invoice found. Their answers are read like any other field.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Id of a dynamic area on the form.

fields.description: Fields as Dictionaries with id, type (text, number, checkbox, dropdown, paragraph, button ...), label and optionally options, default, required, read_only, tooltip.

how.description: G1 (AA parity): replace the area's fields, add these after them, or empty the area.

height.description: G1 (AA parity): the area's height in pixels; more fields then scroll inside it. As tall as its fields when empty.

count.description: Number of fields now in the area.

actions.name: Enable element
actions.description: Let the person use a field or button again.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

actions.name: Get field value
actions.description: Read one field's current value, or all answers when no field is given.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer. Empty for all answers.

value.description: The field's value (all answers as a Dictionary when no field is given).

actions.name: Hide element
actions.description: Hide a field, button or area (a hidden field is not checked).

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

actions.name: Hide form
actions.description: Move the open form's window out of the way (minimised to the task bar) while the agent works; its answers are kept.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

actions.name: Highlight element
actions.description: Draw attention to a field or button with a coloured outline, in your own colour or as a warning or error, optionally with a message under it.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

kind.description: color: the colour below. warning: amber. error: red.

message.description: Text shown under the element in the outline colour; none when empty.

actions.name: Reset form
actions.description: Put every field back to its designer default (or empty) and clear the messages.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

actions.name: Set field value
actions.description: Change a field's value on the open form.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

value.description: New value (text, number, true/false for a checkbox, an option for a drop-down).

how.description: G1 (AA parity): replace the field's value, or add the text after what it holds.

credential.description: G1 (AA parity): a credential from the vault for a password field, instead of a value; it never reaches the log.

actions.name: Set focus
actions.description: Put the cursor in a field (or on a button).

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

actions.name: Show element
actions.description: Show a hidden field, button or area.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

element.description: Field or button id on the form, as set in the form designer.

actions.name: Show form
actions.description: Bring a hidden (minimised) form back in front of the other windows.

name.description: Name of the open form (by default the form's id, as given when it was displayed).

actions.name: Remove highlight

name: Fuzzy Match
description: Score how alike two texts are, pick the closest candidate from a list and join tables on near-matching values.

actions.name: Find closest match
actions.description: Compare a text with every entry of a list and return the closest entry when it scores at least the threshold.

text.description: Text to look for (or use text_file).

candidates.description: Entries to compare with, e.g. a list of customer names.

threshold.description: Lowest score (0 to 100) accepted as a match.

algorithm.description: levenshtein: edit distance, good for typos. jaro_winkler: favours a shared start, good for short names. token_sort: ignores word order. token_set: ignores word order and extra words.

case_sensitive.description: Treat upper and lower case as different.

text_file.description: Text file whose content to look for, instead of text; spaces and line breaks at both ends are removed.

found.description: True when an entry reached the threshold.

match.description: Closest entry, empty when none reached the threshold.

score.description: Score of the closest entry (0 to 100), even when below the threshold.

index.description: Zero-based position of the match in the list, -1 when none.

actions.name: Fuzzy join tables
actions.description: For each row of the first table, find the row of the second table whose column value is closest and append its columns and the score.

left_table.description: Table whose rows you want to enrich.

left_column.description: Column of the first table to match on.

right_table.description: Reference table to look values up in.

right_column.description: Column of the reference table to match on.

threshold.description: Lowest score (0 to 100) accepted as a match.

algorithm.description: levenshtein: edit distance, good for typos. jaro_winkler: favours a shared start, good for short names. token_sort: ignores word order. token_set: ignores word order and extra words.

keep_unmatched.description: Keep rows without a match, with empty reference columns. Off: drop them.

case_sensitive.description: Treat upper and lower case as different.

table.description: First table's columns, then the second table's (renamed with a right_ prefix on a clash), then match_score.

unmatched.description: Rows of the first table without a match.

actions.name: Text similarity

algorithm.description: levenshtein: edit distance, good for typos. jaro_winkler: favours a shared start, good for short names. token_sort: ignores word order. token_set: ignores word order and extra words.

case_sensitive.description: Treat upper and lower case as different.

conditions.name: Texts are similar
conditions.description: True when two texts score at least the threshold (0 to 100).

threshold.description: Lowest score that counts as similar.

algorithm.description: levenshtein: edit distance, good for typos. jaro_winkler: favours a shared start, good for short names. token_sort: ignores word order. token_set: ignores word order and extra words.

message.description: Your next message.

system.description: Instructions for the model's role; set on the first message of a session (a new value replaces the old one).

provider.description: Who runs the model: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), Hugging Face (its router or your own TGI server), AWS SageMaker (a model on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint), AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI (Gemini).

connection.description: Name of a Model Connection (provider, model and key managed in one place). Leave empty to set them on this action.

model.description: Model name; the deployment name for Azure OpenAI; the endpoint name for AWS SageMaker; the model or inference profile id for AWS Bedrock.

api_key.description: API key or access token from the vault (not needed for some self-hosted endpoints). For AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker: the AWS secret access key (or ACCESS_KEY_ID:SECRET). For Google Vertex AI: a service-account JSON key or an access token.

mask_pii.description: Replace emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs and similar before sending; restored in the answer.

history_limit.description: Most messages to keep in the session; the oldest are dropped first.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling: only the most likely words whose chances add up to this share are used (above 0 to 1); provider default when empty.

stop_sequences.description: Up to 4 texts at which the model stops writing.

presence_penalty.description: From -2 to 2; higher values push the model toward new topics (OpenAI-style providers).

frequency_penalty.description: From -2 to 2; higher values make the model repeat itself less (OpenAI-style providers).

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the model; 180 when 0.

name: Google Cloud AI
description: Read sentiment and entities in text with Cloud Natural Language, labels and text in pictures with Cloud Vision, and text, entities, form fields and tables from documents with Document AI.

actions.name: Connect
actions.description: Open a session with an API key, an OAuth access token or a service account key, and the project and location of your Document AI processors.

credential.description: API key, OAuth access token or service account key (the key file's JSON) from the vault.

credential_type.description: api_key: a Google Cloud API key (Natural Language and Vision). access_token: an OAuth token of a service account or user (needed for Document AI). service_account_json: a service account's JSON key, from the vault or a file; the session gets and renews its own access tokens (G6).

key_file.description: The service account's JSON key file, when the key is not in the vault (G6). Keep the file where only the runner's account can read it.

project.description: Google Cloud project id or number; needed for Document AI, and billed for calls made with an access token. It may come from the vault.

location.description: Location of the Document AI processors: us or eu.

endpoint.description: Another address for the APIs, e.g. a Private Service Connect address; {service} in it becomes language, vision or us-documentai (eu-documentai). Leave empty for Google's addresses.

actions.name: Disconnect
actions.description: Close the Google Cloud AI session and forget its key.

actions.name: Process a document
actions.description: Send a document to a Document AI processor (e.g. an invoice, form, OCR or custom extractor) and get its text, entities, form fields and tables; each table becomes a Data Table.

session.description: Name of the session opened by Connect.

processor_id.description: Id of the processor, from its page in the Google Cloud console. It may come from the vault.

file.description: PDF, TIFF, GIF, JPEG, PNG, BMP or WEBP file; at most 20 MB.

project.description: The project that owns the processor, when it is not the one given to Connect (G6). It may come from the vault.

processor_version.description: A processor version id, e.g. pretrained-invoice-v2.0-2023-12-06. Leave empty for the default version.

mime_type.description: Content type of the file, e.g. application/pdf. Leave empty to take it from the file name.

first_row_headers.description: Use each table's header row (or first row) as its column names.

entities.description: What the processor extracted. Columns: type, text, normalized, confidence.

fields.description: Entity type to its text, e.g. {"invoice_id": "INV-100", "total_amount": "110.00"}; repeated types become a list.

form_fields.description: Form fields found on the pages (form parser). Columns: name, value, confidence, page.

tables.description: One Data Table per table found.

language.description: Language of the text, e.g. en, de or ja. Leave empty to detect it.

language.description: Language of the text, as given or detected.

magnitude.description: How strong the feeling is overall, from 0 up.

language.description: Language of the text, as given or detected.

description: Classify documents by type, extract fields by rules, and extract with AI that learns from validated examples.

fields.description: Field name to value (text); fields not found are left out.

examples_file.description: The example file Save validated example writes; none: no examples.

fields.description: The validated values, as a person checked them.

count.description: Examples kept for the type now.

name: Image recognition
description: Find, wait for and click images on the screen or inside image files.

actions.name: Click image
actions.description: Find a picture on the screen (optionally waiting for it, in a region, or its n-th appearance) and click it with the chosen button at its centre, corner or an offset.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in percent (0 = pixel-exact); raise for anti-aliased or scaled screens.

occurrence.description: Which match to use when the picture appears several times, counting in reading order from 1.

position.description: Point reported (and clicked): center of the match, or its top_left corner; offsets are added to it.

offset_x.description: Pixels added to the reported x, e.g. to reach a field to the right of a label picture.

offset_y.description: Pixels added to the reported y.

timeout_seconds.description: Keep looking for up to this many seconds before failing; 0 looks once.

x.description: Search region left; the whole image or screen when the region is empty.

window.description: Look only inside this window (text in its title, * and ?, or re:); x and y then count from its top-left corner (G4).

x.description: Clicked x.

actions.name: Compare images
actions.description: Compare two pictures pixel by pixel: whether they are the same, how much differs, where, and optionally a copy of the first with the changes in red.

image.description: First picture, e.g. the approved layout (PNG, JPG, BMP or GIF).

other.description: Second picture, e.g. a screen capture saved by an earlier step.

tolerance.description: How different one pixel's colour may be and still count as the same, in percent (0 = exact); ignores compression noise and slight colour shifts.

max_difference_percent.description: Share of pixels that may differ while the pictures still count as the same.

size_mismatch.description: When the sizes differ: error stops with IMAGE.SIZE_MISMATCH; scale stretches the second picture to the first one's size first.

difference_image.description: Save a PNG copy of the first picture with the changed pixels in red here; none when empty.

same.description: True when no more than max_difference_percent of the pixels differ.

difference_percent.description: Share of pixels that differ, 0 to 100, two decimals.

changed_area.description: x, y, width and height of the box around every changed pixel (in the first image); empty when nothing changed.

difference_image.description: Path of the difference picture; empty when none was asked for.

actions.name: Find image in image
actions.description: Look for a small picture inside a larger image file, optionally in a region and for its n-th appearance; returns the point of the match.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in percent (0 = pixel-exact); raise for anti-aliased or scaled screens.

occurrence.description: Which match to use when the picture appears several times, counting in reading order from 1.

position.description: Point reported (and clicked): center of the match, or its top_left corner; offsets are added to it.

offset_x.description: Pixels added to the reported x, e.g. to reach a field to the right of a label picture.

offset_y.description: Pixels added to the reported y.

x.description: Search region left; the whole image or screen when the region is empty.

repeat_times.description: How many times to look while the picture is not found; the image file is read again each time, e.g. while another program refreshes it. 1 looks once.

repeat_delay_ms.description: Pause between two looks, in milliseconds.

found.description: True when a match within the tolerance was found.

x.description: Centre x of the match (or the chosen point).

y.description: Centre y of the match (or the chosen point).

similarity.description: Similarity of the best match in percent.

count.description: Number of matches found (up to occurrence when it is above 1).

actions.name: Find image on screen
actions.description: Look for a picture on the screen, optionally in a region and for its n-th appearance; returns the point of the match.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in percent (0 = pixel-exact); raise for anti-aliased or scaled screens.

occurrence.description: Which match to use when the picture appears several times, counting in reading order from 1.

position.description: Point reported (and clicked): center of the match, or its top_left corner; offsets are added to it.

offset_x.description: Pixels added to the reported x, e.g. to reach a field to the right of a label picture.

offset_y.description: Pixels added to the reported y.

x.description: Search region left; the whole image or screen when the region is empty.

timeout_seconds.description: Keep looking for up to this many seconds while the picture is not there; 0 looks once. found is false when time runs out.

interval_ms.description: Pause between two looks at the screen while waiting, in milliseconds.

window.description: Look only inside this window (text in its title, * and ?, or re:); x and y then count from its top-left corner (G4).

found.description: True when found.

x.description: Centre x on screen (or the chosen point).

y.description: Centre y on screen (or the chosen point).

count.description: Number of matches found (up to occurrence when it is above 1).

actions.name: Wait for image
actions.description: Wait until a picture appears on the screen, or disappears from it, checking a region at a chosen interval (IMAGE.NOT_FOUND after the timeout).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in percent (0 = pixel-exact); raise for anti-aliased or scaled screens.

interval_ms.description: Pause between two looks at the screen, in milliseconds.

until_gone.description: Wait for the picture to disappear instead, e.g. a loading spinner.

x.description: Search region left; the whole image or screen when the region is empty.
Centre x on screen.

actions.name: Wait for screen change
actions.description: Wait until a region of the screen changes (e.g. a result appears), or until it stops changing (e.g. a page or application has finished drawing).

mode.description: change: wait until the region differs from how it looked at the start; settle: wait until it stays the same for stable_ms.

threshold_percent.description: Share of the region's pixels that must differ to count as a change (ignores a blinking cursor).

stable_ms.description: settle: how long the region must stay unchanged.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait.

interval_ms.description: Pause between two looks at the screen.

fail_on_timeout.description: Fail with IMAGE.NO_CHANGE (or IMAGE.NOT_STEADY) when time runs out; otherwise changed is false.

x.description: Region left; the whole screen when the region is empty.

window.description: Title of a window to watch: it is brought to the front and the region is measured from its top-left corner (the whole window when the region is empty).

initial_wait_ms.description: Wait this long before the first look, e.g. while a click starts the change.

changed.description: True when the awaited change (or the steady state) happened in time.

changed_percent.description: How much of the region differed from the first look, in percent.

conditions.name: Image is in image file
conditions.description: True when the picture appears inside an image file.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in percent (0 = pixel-exact); raise for anti-aliased or scaled screens.

conditions.name: Image is on screen
conditions.description: True when the picture is visible on the screen, or inside one window, within the tolerance.

tolerance.description: Allowed difference in percent (0 = pixel-exact); raise for anti-aliased or scaled screens.

window.description: Look only inside this window (text in its title, * and ?, or re:); x and y then count from its top-left corner (G4).

wait_seconds.description: Keep looking this many seconds until it is there; 0 looks once (G4).

occurrence.description: True only when the picture appears at least this many times (G4).

click_if_found.description: Also click the picture when it is there (G4).

name: Insights
description: Record business values and timed transactions from agents for dashboards and ROI reports, and read them back.

actions.name: Close transaction
actions.description: End a transaction opened with Open transaction and record its values, outcome and duration for dashboards.

values.description: Business values to record, e.g. {"amount": 120, "supplier": "Acme"}; leave out sensitive fields. Credentials are refused.

status.description: G1 (AA parity): a status in your own words (or from a variable), recorded instead of the outcome when given.

include_variables.description: G1 (AA parity): also record every variable of the agent (credentials never), after the values listed.

actions.name: Open transaction
actions.description: Mark the start of a business transaction (e.g. one invoice); Close transaction records its values and how long it took.

transaction.description: Transaction name; Close transaction must use the same name.

actions.name: Read business values
actions.description: Read recorded values for a category as a table, optionally for a time range or one transaction name.

since.description: Only records on or after this date (UTC).

transaction.description: Only records of this transaction name (from Close transaction).

max_records.description: Return only the newest this many records; all when 0.

actions.name: Tag business values
actions.description: Record a set of values for a category, e.g. invoices: {amount, supplier, minutes_saved}.

values.description: Values to record; Credentials are refused.

name: Interrupt handlers
description: Rules that deal with unexpected windows and pop-ups during UI automation, checked before each UI action.

actions.name: Add interrupt rule
actions.description: Add (or replace by name) a rule for this run: when a window or element appears, or a condition becomes true, click, press keys, close the window or run a child agent.

name.description: Rule name; adding a rule with the same name replaces it.

when_window.description: Window title pattern: text the title contains, a wildcard pattern with * and ?, or re: followed by a regular expression.

when_element.description: Element selector that marks the pop-up, looked for in the browser session below.

then.description: Response: click the target, press the target keys, close the matched window, run the target agent, or only log it.

target.description: For click: a selector in the browser session or x,y screen coordinates; for press_keys: keys such as ENTER or ALT+F4; for run_agent: the agent id.

max_times.description: Respond at most this many times in the run; 0 means no limit.

when_condition.description: Any condition, as for If (a toolkit's condition such as Image found), that marks the interruption; variables in it are read when the rule is added (Watch for interruptions reads them each time).

actions.name: Check interrupt rules now
actions.description: Check the rules immediately, for example after a step that often raises a pop-up, and respond to any that match.

handled.description: Names of the rules that responded.

actions.name: Clear interrupt rules
actions.description: Remove every interrupt rule from this run.

actions.name: List interrupt rules
actions.description: Return the active rules and how often each has responded.

actions.name: Remove interrupt rule
actions.description: Remove one interrupt rule by name.

removed.description: True when a rule with that name existed.

name: Java apps
description: Find and work with the controls of desktop applications written in Java (Swing and AWT): read and type text, press buttons, read labels and tables.

actions.name: Find Java objects
actions.description: List the controls of a Java application's window: name, role, text, state, actions and position, each with its path.

window_title.description: Title of the application's window: text it contains, or a pattern with * and ?.

name.description: Name of the control (contains, or * and ?); empty for any.

role.description: Java accessibility role, e.g. push button, text, label, check box, combo box, table (contains, or * and ?).

process.description: Part of the Java program's name (its main class or jar, as Get Java applications lists it); narrows the search and is needed for programs named like tools.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for at least one match, in seconds; 0 looks once.

objects.description: Matching controls: path, name, role, description, text, enabled, visible, editable, checked, actions, bounds, pid.

actions.name: Get Java applications
actions.description: List the Java programs running as the runner's user that have windows, with their window titles.

process.description: Part of the Java program's name (its main class or jar, as Get Java applications lists it); narrows the search and is needed for programs named like tools.

apps.description: One dictionary per program: pid, name and windows (their titles).

actions.name: Java object action
actions.description: Act on a control of a Java application: press it (its action), type text into it, read its text, give it the focus, or read its properties. Find it by name and role, or by path.

window_title.description: Title of the application's window: text it contains, or a pattern with * and ?.

name.description: Name of the control (contains, or * and ?).

role.description: Java accessibility role, e.g. push button, text, label, check box, combo box, table (contains, or * and ?).

index.description: Which match to use when several do, 0 for the first.

path.description: The control's path from Find Java objects, instead of name and role.

action.description: do_action presses a button, toggles a box or opens a menu; set_text replaces the text of a field; G4 adds clicks, states, selections, tables and cells, trees and menus by path (File > Save), sliders and scrolling, as for other desktop applications.

value.description: The text to type (set_text, set_cell_text; a password may come from the vault), the item, path, position, text to find or scroll direction (up, down, left, right); or the name of the action to do when the control has several.

process.description: Part of the Java program's name (its main class or jar, as Get Java applications lists it); narrows the search and is needed for programs named like tools.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the control, in seconds.

row.description: Table cells: the row, 1 for the first; select_item: the item's position from 1; scroll: how many times (G4).

column.description: Table cells: the column, 1 for the first (G4).

click_kind.description: click and click_cell: left, right or double; scroll: a line or a page at a time (G4).

result.description: The text read (get_text), the properties (get_properties), or true.

object.description: The control acted on: path, name, role, text and the rest.

actions.name: Pick Java object
actions.description: Point at a control of a Java application and press Ctrl+Shift+C to capture it: its window, path, name and role, ready for Java object action (G4).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for Ctrl+Shift+C.

process.description: Part of the Java program's name (its main class or jar, as Get Java applications lists it); narrows the search and is needed for programs named like tools.

object.description: The control: window, path, name, role, text and the rest.

name: Jobs and alerts
description: See and stop other agent runs, and raise alerts to people, from an agent run by One CommandCenter.

actions.name: Get job
actions.description: Read the state of another run: running, success, failed or stopped, when it started and ended, and its error. The run's user must be allowed to see runs of that agent.

job.description: id, bot_path (the agent), status, requested_by, run_as, device_name, created, started, finished, duration_ms, error_code, error_message.

status.description: queued, running, success, failed or stopped.

actions.name: List jobs
actions.description: List runs the run's user may see: the active ones (queued or running), the finished ones, or all; of one agent or of every agent; newest first.

status.description: active: queued or running; history: finished; all.

agent.description: Only runs of this agent (its path in the repository); every agent when empty.

jobs.description: One record per run, as Get job returns it.

actions.name: Raise alert
actions.description: Raise an alert in Operational Insights > Alerts. It goes to the people, e-mail addresses and webhook of the alert rules of kind Raised by an agent (for every agent or this one); with no such rule it is only listed there. It stays open until someone acknowledges it. A run raises at most 20 alerts, and the same subject once.

message.description: What happened and what a person should do.
examples: Invoice 4711 from Acme is over the approval limit

severity.description: How serious it is; the alert's title says Critical for critical.

subject.description: What the alert is about; the same subject is raised once per run. Every alert is new when empty.

alerts.description: How many alerts were raised (one per rule that takes them; 0 when this subject was already raised by this run).

actions.name: Stop job
actions.description: Stop another run: a queued run is removed, a running one stops at its next step. Needs the run's user to be allowed to stop runs; an agent stops itself with Stop agent instead.

stopped.description: True when the run was queued or running and is being stopped; false when it had already ended.

status.description: stopping, or the state it had already ended in.

save_to.description: Save the document to this file before closing; not saved when empty.

encoding.description: Text encoding of the saved file, e.g. utf-8, utf-8-bom, utf-16.

value.description: The document as the session held it.

path.description: The file written; empty when nothing was saved.
