actions.name: Wait for text
actions.description: Wait until text appears (or disappears) on the screen or at a position.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait.

row.description: Only look at text starting at this row (1-based); anywhere when empty.

column.description: Column (1-based) of that position.

case_sensitive.description: Match upper and lower case exactly.

wait_until_gone.description: Wait until the text is no longer shown, e.g. a PLEASE WAIT message.

fail_on_timeout.description: Stop with an error on timeout; when off, found is false instead.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to look at the screen.

found.description: True when the condition was met in time (false only when fail_on_timeout is off).

name: Trigger Loop
description: Wait for events (file and folder changes, timer ticks, programs starting or stopping, windows opening or closing, services changing state, form events, new e-mails or records, key presses, clicks) and run the loop's nested steps once per event.

conditions.name: Program is running
conditions.description: True when at least one process with this executable name is running.

iterators.name: Each new or changed file in folder
iterators.description: Wait for files (or folders) to appear, change, go or be renamed in a folder and run the nested steps once for each; gives the change, path, name, size and time (UTC, like every DateTime).

folder.description: Folder to watch.

pattern.description: Glob for file names, e.g. *.pdf.

include_existing.description: Also handle files already in the folder when the loop starts.

settle_seconds.description: Wait until a file has not changed for this long, so half-copied files are skipped until complete.

poll_seconds.description: How often to check, in seconds.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

event.description: Which change starts the steps: a file that appears (created), changes, goes, is renamed, or any of these.

include_subfolders.description: Also watch everything in the folders under it.

iterators.name: Each event on an open form
iterators.description: Run the nested steps each time the person presses a button, changes a field or submits the open form (Display form with Wait off); the loop ends when the form closes.

name.description: Name of the open form, as given when it was displayed.

element.description: Only events of this field or button (its id in the form designer); any when empty.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

iterators.name: Each time a key is pressed
iterators.description: Windows only. Run the nested steps each time the named key or combination (such as F9, CTRL+ENTER or SHIFT+F2) is pressed, optionally only while a given window is in front. Typed text is never recorded: the event gives only the key, the window title and the process. The key still reaches the application.

key.description: The key or combination: CTRL, ALT, SHIFT, WIN with one key such as A-Z, 0-9, F1-F24, ENTER, TAB, ESC, arrows. Letters and digits need CTRL, ALT or WIN.

window.description: Only while this window is in front: title text, a pattern with * and ?, or re: and a regular expression. Empty: any window.

process.description: Only in this program, such as excel.exe. Empty: any program.

debounce_ms.description: Ignore repeats within this many milliseconds of the last event.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

iterators.name: Each click in a window
iterators.description: Windows only. Run the nested steps each time the person clicks in a given window, optionally only on a given element (name, type, automation id as captured). The event gives the button, the window title, the process and the element's name, type and automation id; never screen contents. Clicks made by programs are ignored.

window.description: The window: title text, a pattern with * and ?, or re: and a regular expression. Give this or the process.

process.description: The program, such as excel.exe. Give this or the window.

element_name.description: Only clicks on an element with this name (text, * and ? pattern, or re:). Empty: any element.

element_type.description: Only clicks on this type of element, such as Button or MenuItem. Empty: any type.

automation_id.description: Only clicks on the element with this automation id. Empty: any.

debounce_ms.description: Ignore repeats within this many milliseconds of the last event.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

iterators.name: Each new e-mail, record or item
iterators.description: Read a loop type (such as Each email in a mailbox, Outlook, Exchange or Gmail) or a command's list (such as ServiceNow Query records) again and again, and run the nested steps for each item not seen before, or changed since.

source.description: The loop type (toolkit/loop type) or command (toolkit/command) whose items are watched.

source_inputs.description: The source's fields, such as the folder, the sender or subject filter, or the query; keep secrets in a saved connection.

connection.description: Saved connection that gives the source its address and sign-in.

list_output.description: For a command: the output that holds the list; its first list output when empty.

key.description: Field that tells items apart, such as id, message_id or sys_id; the whole item when empty.

changed_field.description: Also run the steps for an item seen before when this field has changed (an updated record).

include_existing.description: Also handle the items there when the loop starts.

poll_seconds.description: How often to read the source, in seconds.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

iterators.name: Each time a program starts or stops
iterators.description: Watch for a program (by executable name, e.g. excel or notepad.exe) to start, or to stop, and run the nested steps for each process.

process_name.description: Executable name, with or without .exe; not case-sensitive.

poll_seconds.description: How often to check, in seconds.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

event.description: Start the steps when the program starts, or when one of its processes ends.

iterators.name: Each time a service changes state
iterators.description: Windows only. Watch a service and run the nested steps when it starts, stops, pauses or resumes; gives the change and the new state.

service.description: Service name (not its display name), e.g. Spooler.

include_current.description: Also run the steps once at the start for the state the service is in (is running, has stopped, is paused).

poll_seconds.description: How often to check, in seconds.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

iterators.name: Every interval
iterators.description: Run the nested steps on a fixed interval, e.g. every 60 seconds; gives the tick number and time (UTC).

run_immediately.description: Fire the first tick at once instead of after one interval.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

iterators.name: Each time a window opens or closes
iterators.description: Watch for a window whose title fits a pattern to open, or to close, and run the nested steps for each; gives the change and the window's title.

title.description: Window title: text the title contains, a pattern with * and ?, or re: and a regular expression.

event.description: Start the steps when such a window opens, closes, or either.

include_existing.description: Also count windows already open when the loop starts as opening.

poll_seconds.description: How often to check, in seconds.

max_events.description: Stop after this many events; 0 = no limit.

max_seconds.description: Stop waiting after this many seconds in total; 0 = no limit (until the run is stopped or an Exit loop step runs).

name: Credential vault
description: Save a credential's new value in One CommandCenter's vault, for example after a password reset, and check when a credential expires.

actions.name: Check credential expiry
actions.description: Read when a credential expires, how many days are left and whether it has expired. The user the run runs as must be able to use the vault folder.

credential.description: vault folder/credential, or folder/credential/attribute (the expiry belongs to the whole credential).

warn_days.description: Report expiring_soon when this many days or fewer are left.

expires.description: The expiry date (yyyy-MM-dd), or empty when it has none.

days_left.description: Days until it expires (negative once past); empty when it has no expiry date.

expired.description: True when the expiry date has passed.

expiring_soon.description: True when it expires within warn_days (and has not expired yet).

has_expiry.description: True when the credential has an expiry date.

actions.name: Save credential value
actions.description: Store a new value of a credential attribute in One CommandCenter's vault, for example the new password after a reset, and optionally its new expiry date. Needs Settings > Agents may save credentials and permission to change the credential for the user the run runs as.

credential.description: Where to store it: vault folder/credential/attribute, e.g. finance/sap-login/password.

value.description: The new value: a Credential variable or a vault reference, never typed text.

expires.description: The credential's new expiry date, yyyy-MM-dd. Empty: unchanged.

expires_in_days.description: Or: the credential expires this many days from today (used when expires is empty).

expires.description: The credential's expiry date (yyyy-MM-dd), or empty when it has none.

days_left.description: Days until it expires; empty when it has no expiry date.

conditions.name: Credential has expired
conditions.description: True when the credential's expiry date has passed.

name: Web goal agent
description: Reach a goal on a web page described in plain words: an AI model reads the page and clicks, types and selects until done.

actions.name: End web agent session
actions.description: Close the browser the web agent session opened.

actions.name: Reach a goal
actions.description: Describe the goal in plain words; the AI model works the page in a browser session until the goal is reached, cannot be reached, or the step limit. Can start from an address and return its findings in a given shape (JSON Schema), also as a file.

goal.description: What to achieve, in plain words; ${...} interpolation allowed. Empty when goals lists them.
examples: Search for invoice 4711 and tell me its total and due date.

session.description: Browser session (from Start web agent session or Open browser).

allowed_sites.description: Host names the agent may visit (sub-domains included), e.g. ["portal.example.com"]; any site when empty.

secrets.description: Name to Credential, e.g. {"password": a Credential}. The model types them as {{secret:password}} and never sees the values.

instructions.description: Extra rules, e.g. "Never press Delete or Pay."

provider.description: Who runs the model: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible (LiteLLM, vLLM, Ollama), Hugging Face (its router or your own TGI server), AWS SageMaker (a model on an Amazon SageMaker endpoint), AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI (Gemini).

connection.description: Name of a Model Connection (provider, model and key managed in one place). Leave empty to set them on this action.

model.description: Model name; the deployment name for Azure OpenAI; the endpoint name for AWS SageMaker; the model or inference profile id for AWS Bedrock.

api_key.description: API key or access token from the vault (not needed for some self-hosted endpoints). For AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker: the AWS secret access key (or ACCESS_KEY_ID:SECRET). For Google Vertex AI: a service-account JSON key or an access token.

base_url.description: Endpoint; required for Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI (https://REGION-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/REGION) and self-hosted models (for a TGI server, e.g. http://tgi-host:8080/v1).

mask_pii.description: Replace emails, phone and card numbers, IBANs and similar before sending; restored in the answer.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker only: AWS access key id from the vault (api_key then holds the secret access key).

aws_region.description: AWS Bedrock and AWS SageMaker only: AWS region, e.g. eu-west-1.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the model on each step; 180 when 0.

start_url.description: Open this address before the first step; the page already open when empty.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema the data output must match; the model is shown it and asked to correct an answer that does not match.

output_path.description: Also write the data output to this JSON file when the goal is reached.

save_trajectory_to.description: Keep a record of the run in this JSON file: each step's action, the model's reasoning and a screenshot (saved in a folder next to it). Secrets appear only as placeholders.

goals.description: More goals, reached one after another in the same browser (after goal, when it is given); each gets its own result in goal_results, and a goal not reached stops the rest (G4).

time_limit_seconds.description: Most time for the whole step, all goals together; no limit when 0. A goal is not started once the time is used up (G4).

success.description: Whether the model reports the goal reached.

data.description: Values the goal asked for, if any.

url.description: Address of the page at the end.

input_tokens.description: Tokens sent to the model in all steps.

output_tokens.description: Tokens the model answered with in all steps.

goal_results.description: With several goals or a time limit: each goal with its success, answer and data (G4).

main.tick: Return the findings in a fixed shape

actions.name: Start web agent session
actions.description: Open a browser for the web goal agent (the same session works with every Browser action).

headless.description: Run without a visible window (for unattended agents).

proxy_server.description: Send the browser's traffic through this proxy: host:port, or with http://, https://, socks4:// or socks5:// in front.

proxy_username.description: User name for a proxy that asks for one; it may come from the vault (G4).

proxy_password.description: Password for the proxy, from the vault; never logged.

browser_path.description: Start this browser program instead of the installed one (a Chromium-based browser, or Firefox when browser is firefox).

name: Window
description: Find, activate, move, resize, minimise, maximise, close and capture application windows on Windows.

actions.name: Activate window
actions.description: Bring a window to the front (restoring it if minimised).

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the activated window.

actions.name: Capture window
actions.description: Save a PNG screenshot of one window.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

activate.description: Bring the window to the front first so nothing covers it.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file; when false an existing file stops the step.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

actions.name: Close window
actions.description: Ask a window to close (like clicking its X; the program may ask to save).

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

wait_closed_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to disappear; 0 does not wait.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

closed.description: True when the window was gone by the end of wait_closed_seconds (always true when not waiting).

actions.name: Close all matching windows
actions.description: Ask every visible window whose title matches to close (like clicking each X); programs may still ask to save.

title.description: Text in the window titles, a pattern with * or ?, or re: and a regular expression (case-insensitive); the tick below reads the whole title as a regular expression, as older agents do. Empty: every window except those to keep (G4).

use_regex.description: Treat title as a regular expression.

keep.description: Windows to leave open: text in their titles (case-insensitive), e.g. ["Invoices.xlsx"]. The agent's own windows are always kept.

closed.description: Titles of the windows asked to close.

count.description: Number of windows asked to close.

actions.name: Get active window title
actions.description: Return the title of the window in front.

title.description: Title of the foreground window.

process_name.description: Program file name of the foreground window, e.g. EXCEL.EXE.

class_name.description: Window class of the foreground window.

actions.name: Get window details
actions.description: Find a window and return its title, program, class, position, size and state, e.g. to keep it in a variable for later steps.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

window.description: title, process_name, class_name, x, y, width, height, state (normal, minimized or maximized), active, process_id.

x.description: Left edge in pixels.

process_id.description: Id of the program that owns the window, for Stop program.

actions.name: Hide window
actions.description: Hide a window completely: unlike Minimise it also leaves the taskbar. The program keeps running, and Show window brings it back.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

show_at_end.description: Show the window again when the run ends (also when it fails), so no invisible windows are left behind. Turn off to keep it hidden after the run.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the hidden window.

actions.name: List windows
actions.description: List the titles of all visible windows.

actions.name: Maximise window
actions.description: Maximise a window.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the window.

actions.name: Minimise window
actions.description: Minimise a window.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the window.

actions.name: Move and resize window
actions.description: Set a window's position and/or size in pixels; values left empty keep the window's current ones.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

x.description: Left; unchanged when empty.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

actions.name: Pick a point on screen
actions.description: Design time: point at a place in any window and press Ctrl+Shift+C. Gives the point on the screen and measured from the window's top-left corner, with the window's title and size, for mouse steps.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the Ctrl+Shift+C press, in seconds.

x.description: Horizontal position from the window's left edge.

y.description: Vertical position from the window's top edge.

screen_x.description: Horizontal position from the screen's left edge.

screen_y.description: Vertical position from the screen's top edge.

window.description: Title of the window under the pointer; empty over the desktop.

actions.name: Restore window
actions.description: Restore a minimised or maximised window to its normal size.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the window.

actions.name: Set window title
actions.description: Change the title bar text of a window, e.g. to tell several copies of the same program apart.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

actions.name: Show window
actions.description: Show a window that was hidden (by Hide window or by its program), optionally bringing it to the front.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ?, or re: and a regular expression (case-insensitive). Hidden windows are searched first, then visible ones. May be empty when process_id is given.

activate.description: Also bring the window to the front.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the window shown.

actions.name: Type in background
actions.description: Type text and keys such as {ENTER} or {TAB} into a window without bringing it to the front or using the keyboard, so it works while the window is behind others or minimised and the person keeps working.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

text.description: Text to type; {ENTER}, {TAB}, {BACKSPACE}, {DELETE}, {ESC}, arrows, {HOME}, {END}, {F1}-{F12} press those keys ({TAB 3} three times; a { inside braces types a {). A Credential is typed without being logged.

control_class.description: Window class of the control to type into, or a pattern with * and ?; the window's focused control when empty.

control_index.description: Which control of that class (0 is the first).

method.description: type sends each character and key to the control; replace sets the control's whole text (edit boxes); append adds the text at the end of it.

delay_ms.description: Pause after each character or key, for programs that read input slowly.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

timeout_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the window to appear; 0 looks once.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

control_class.description: Class of the control typed into, e.g. Edit.

control_text.description: The control's text afterwards, when it reports one (edit boxes do), to check the result.

actions.name: Wait for window
actions.description: Wait until a window whose title matches (or the main window of a process) opens, or until it has closed.

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ? (e.g. Invoice*- Excel), or re: and a regular expression; case-insensitive. The first visible window that matches is used. May be empty when process_id is given.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum wait.

alternatives.description: Fallbacks when no title matches: title_pattern (wildcards or re:), class_name, process_name, and index (with class_name). The one that works is logged.

state.description: open: wait until the window is there; close: wait until no window with this title is left.

fail_on_timeout.description: Fail the step when time runs out; when off, met is false and the agent carries on.

process_id.description: Process id from Start program: use that program's main window instead of finding it by title; title, when given, then only narrows the choice.

title.description: Full title of the window that opened (or that was open when waiting for it to close).

met.description: True when the window opened or closed in time.

conditions.name: Window exists
conditions.description: True when a visible window title matches (text in it, * or ? pattern, or re:).

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ?, or re: and a regular expression (case-insensitive).

wait_seconds.description: Keep trying this many seconds until it is true; 0 checks once (G4).

conditions.name: Window is active
conditions.description: True when the window in front has a matching title (text in it, * or ? pattern, or re:).

title.description: Text in the window title, a pattern with * or ?, or re: and a regular expression (case-insensitive).

wait_seconds.description: Keep trying this many seconds until it is true; 0 checks once (G4).

name: Word
description: Open or create .docx documents, read text and tables, replace text, add paragraphs and tables, save.

actions.name: Add paragraph
actions.description: Append a paragraph, optionally bold or with a style such as Heading1.

style.description: Style of the document by id or name, e.g. Heading1 or Heading 1; Heading1-6, Title, Subtitle and Quote are added to documents that lack them.

actions.name: Insert table
actions.description: Insert a table built from a Data Table (header row first) at the end, after a marker text or at a bookmark, optionally with a table style.

include_header.description: Put the column names in a bold first row.

after_text.description: Insert after the paragraph containing this text; at the end when empty.

bookmark.description: Insert after the paragraph holding this bookmark; used when after_text is empty.

style.description: Table style id defined in the document, e.g. TableGrid.

title.description: Alternative-text title of the table, read by screen readers (Word: Table Properties > Alt Text > Title).

alt_description.description: Alternative-text description of the table (Word: Table Properties > Alt Text > Description).

actions.name: Close
actions.description: Close the document, saving the changes first when asked.

save.description: Save the changes to the opened file before closing.

actions.name: Create document
actions.description: Create a new .docx (or .doc, .rtf or .odt) file on disk, empty or as a copy of a template document, optionally password-protected, and open it as a named session.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already exists at the path.

password.description: Encrypt the new file with this password; later saves keep it.

template.description: Existing .docx whose content and styles the new document starts from; empty document when empty.

edit_password.description: Restrict editing with this password: Word opens the document read-only until the password is given (Review > Restrict Editing > Stop Protection).

share.description: Agents this one runs may use it.

main.tick: Require a password to open the file
Require a password to edit the file

actions.name: Extract text from a file
actions.description: Return the whole text of a .doc, .docx or .rtf file without opening it as a session; old .doc and .rtf files included.

actions.name: Find and replace picture
actions.description: Swap an existing picture, found by its alternative text or its position in the document, for a new image file, optionally resizing it and changing its alternative text.

alt_text.description: Replace every picture whose alternative text equals this.

index.description: 1-based position of the picture in the document; used when alt_text is empty.

occurrence.description: With alt_text: replace all matching pictures, or only the first or last one in document order.

new_alt_text.description: New alternative text for the replaced pictures; kept when empty.

width.description: New width in points; kept when empty (with only height, the width follows the new image's ratio).

height.description: New height in points; kept when empty (with only width, the height follows the new image's ratio).

page.description: Only look at pictures on this 1-based page of the body; index then counts the pictures on that page.

actions.name: Format text
actions.description: Apply bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, font, size or colour to occurrences of a text in the document, a paragraph range, a bookmark or a page; inputs left empty are not changed.

text.description: Text to format wherever it appears.

whole_word.description: Only match the text as a whole word, not inside a longer word.

occurrence.description: Which occurrences to change, in document order: all, the first or the last.

highlight.description: Highlighter colour behind the text, or none to remove it.

from_paragraph.description: 1-based first body paragraph to search; the whole document (with tables, headers and footers) when both are empty.

to_paragraph.description: 1-based last body paragraph to search, included; to the end when empty.

page.description: Only format text on this 1-based page of the body.

bookmark.description: Only format text in the paragraphs a bookmark covers.

actions.name: Get page count
actions.description: Count the document's pages, from the page layout Word saved in the file or from its page and section breaks.

page_breaks.description: How pages are counted: auto uses the page layout Word saved in the file when there is one, else the page and section breaks stored in it; layout uses only Word's saved layout; breaks uses only the stored breaks (pages Word fills up on its own are then not counted).

counted_from.description: layout (Word's saved layout) or breaks (stored page and section breaks).

actions.name: Insert picture
actions.description: Insert an image file at the start or end of the document, after a marker text or at a bookmark, optionally sized and aligned.

image.description: Image file (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, EMF or WMF).

width.description: Width in points (72 per inch); the height keeps the aspect ratio. Original size when empty.

after_text.description: Put the picture in a new paragraph after the paragraph with this text; at the end when empty.

alt_text.description: Alternative text, also used later by find_replace_picture.

height.description: Height in points; with width both are used as given, alone the width keeps the aspect ratio.

position.description: Where the picture goes when after_text and bookmark are empty: end or start of the document.

bookmark.description: Put the picture in a new paragraph after the paragraph holding this bookmark.

alignment.description: Horizontal alignment of the picture's paragraph; unchanged when empty.

actions.name: Insert text
actions.description: Insert text, or HTML (headings, lists, tables, links, formatting and pictures), at the start or end of the document, or just before or after a marker text or a bookmark, optionally with its own font formatting.

text.description: Text to insert; line breaks are kept.

position.description: Where to insert: end, start of the document, after_text, before_text, bookmark, or cursor: where the last Insert text of this session ended (G3, AA's cursor; the end at first).

anchor.description: Marker text or bookmark name the position refers to.

new_paragraph.description: Put the text in its own paragraph; false adds it inside the existing paragraph.

bold.description: Bold on or off for the inserted text; unchanged when empty.

italic.description: Italic on or off for the inserted text.

underline.description: Single underline on or off for the inserted text.

size.description: Font size in points for the inserted text.

color.description: Hex colour for the inserted text.

font.description: Font name for the inserted text, e.g. Calibri.

as_html.description: The text is HTML: headings, paragraphs, bold/italic/underline, colours and sizes, links, bulleted and numbered lists, tables and pictures (data: URIs or local files) become Word formatting; it always starts in its own paragraph.

actions.name: Open document
actions.description: Open a .docx, .doc, .rtf or .odt document, or create a new one, as a named session; can open password-protected .docx files, check the password to edit and open read-only. .doc, .rtf and .odt files are converted with Word or LibreOffice on the runner and saved back in their own format.

create.description: Create the document when it does not exist.

read_only.description: Open for reading only: save over the opened file is refused, save_as to another file still works.

password.description: Password of an encrypted document; saves keep the file encrypted with it.

edit_password.description: Password to edit a document whose editing is restricted; a wrong one stops the step. Without it such a file still opens.

share.description: Agents this one runs may use it.

main.tick: The file has a password to edit

actions.name: Read tables
actions.description: Read every table in the document, one table by position or one table by its title, optionally only some of its rows and columns; the first row read can become the column names.

index.description: 1-based position of the one table to read; all tables when empty.

header.description: The first row read holds the column names; false names the columns Column1, Column2 and keeps the first row as data.

title.description: Read the one table with this title: the table's alternative-text title, or a Caption-style paragraph just above or below it that contains this text (case is ignored). Used instead of index.

from_row.description: 1-based first row of the table to read, counting the header row; the first when empty.

to_row.description: 1-based last row to read, included; the last when empty.

from_column.description: 1-based first column to read; the first when empty.

to_column.description: 1-based last column to read, included; the last when empty.

count.description: Number of tables in the document.

table.description: The table chosen by index or title; the first table when both are empty, or empty when there is none.

actions.name: Read text
actions.description: Return the paragraph text, one paragraph per line, of the whole body, a range of paragraphs, the text inside a bookmark or one page, optionally with tables, headers and footers.

include_tables.description: Also return the text of table cells, in document order, one cell per line.

include_headers_footers.description: Also return the text of page headers (before the body) and footers (after it).

from_paragraph.description: 1-based first body paragraph to read; the first when empty.

to_paragraph.description: 1-based last body paragraph to read; the last when empty.

bookmark.description: Read only the text between the start and end of this bookmark (tables inside it included); overrides the paragraph range and page.

page.description: Read only this 1-based page (see page_breaks for how pages are counted); overrides the paragraph range.

page_breaks.description: How pages are counted: auto uses the page layout Word saved in the file when there is one, else the page and section breaks stored in it; layout uses only Word's saved layout; breaks uses only the stored breaks (pages Word fills up on its own are then not counted).

actions.name: Find and replace text
actions.description: Find text everywhere (body, tables, headers, footers) or in a paragraph range, bookmark or page and count it, or replace it, e.g. fill {{customer}} placeholders; can ignore case, match whole words or take only the first or last occurrence.

replace_with.description: Replacement text; empty removes what is found.

whole_word.description: Only match the text as a whole word, not inside a longer word.

occurrence.description: Which occurrences to change, in document order: all, the first or the last.

from_paragraph.description: 1-based first body paragraph to search; the whole document (with tables, headers and footers) when both are empty.

to_paragraph.description: 1-based last body paragraph to search, included; to the end when empty.

page.description: Only look on this 1-based page of the body (from Word's saved page layout, else the stored page breaks).

replace.description: Replace what is found with the replacement text (empty removes it); when off the step only counts the matches and changes nothing (the default for new steps).

bookmark.description: Only look in the paragraphs a bookmark covers.

count.description: Number of matches found, or of replacements made.

actions.name: Save
actions.description: Save the document, optionally to a new path; password-protected documents stay protected.

path.description: Save-as path; the opened file when empty.

password.description: Encrypt the saved file with this password; the password the document was opened with when empty.

actions.name: Save as
actions.description: Save the document to a new .docx, .doc, .rtf or .odt file (.docx optionally password-protected) and continue the session on it, or export it as PDF or its text as a .txt file.

format.description: docx keeps the document; doc (Word 97-2003), rtf and odt are written with Microsoft Word (or LibreOffice) on the runner; pdf exports it the same way; txt writes the plain text (body, tables and headers). After pdf and txt the session stays on the previous file.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already exists at the target path; off stops with WORD.EXISTS (the default for new steps).

password.description: Encrypt the new .docx file with this password; later saves keep it.

name: Workday
description: Search and read Workday workers and call Workday REST endpoints or RaaS reports.

actions.name: Authenticate
actions.description: Get an OAuth access token for a registered API client from its refresh token, for the other Workday actions.

client_id.description: Client id of the API client registered in Workday.

client_secret.description: Client secret from the vault.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token issued to the API client, from the vault.

session.description: Keep this sign-in for the steps after it under this name; the toolkit's default session when empty (G6).

share.description: Agents this one runs use the same session (G6).

access_token.description: Access token; map it to access_token of later actions.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the access token expires, when Workday says.

actions.name: End session
actions.description: Forget the open Workday session; later steps then need their own address and sign-in (G6).

session.description: The session; the toolkit's default session when empty.

closed.description: True when a session was open.

actions.name: Call REST endpoint (GET)
actions.description: GET any Workday REST resource or RaaS report URL path and return the JSON.

access_token.description: OAuth access token from the vault.

actions.name: Get integration event
actions.description: Read the status and timing of an integration run.

event_id.description: Integration event WID from Launch integration.

user.description: Integration system user with tenant (basic sign-in).

password.description: Password from the vault (basic sign-in).

access_token.description: OAuth access token from the vault (instead of user and password).

id_type.description: Kind of id in event_id: WID (the 32-character Workday ID that Launch integration returns) or Background_Process_Instance_ID (the process id shown for the run); a variable may hold another ID type name your tenant accepts (G6).

status.description: Run status, e.g. Processing, Completed, Completed with Warnings or Failed.

percent_complete.description: Progress percentage when Workday reports it.

done.description: True once the run has finished, whether it succeeded or not.

actions.name: Get report (RaaS)
actions.description: Run a custom report exposed as a web service and return its rows as a table.

format.description: Format to request from Workday: json, csv, simple_xml, or workday_xml (which adds reference ids such as WIDs as extra columns).

user.description: Integration system user (basic sign-in), e.g. isu_reports@acme.

password.description: Password from the vault (basic sign-in).

access_token.description: OAuth access token from the vault (instead of user and password).

save_to_file.description: Also save Workday's answer, unchanged, to this file; nothing is saved when empty.

table.description: Report rows; columns are the report's field aliases.

path.description: The saved file, when save_to_file was given.

more.tick: Also save the answer to a file

actions.name: Launch EIB with file
actions.description: Start an inbound EIB with a file to load (a spreadsheet or XML attached at launch) through the Integrations web service's Launch_EIB, and return the event id to track it.

integration_system_id.description: Integration System ID of the EIB to start.

file.description: File to load: the EIB's spreadsheet template filled in, or XML.

file_field.description: Name of the EIB data source field that takes the file at launch, as the EIB's Launch / Schedule page shows it.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file; worked out from the file name (.xlsx, .xls, .xml, .csv, .txt) when empty.

user.description: Integration system user with tenant, e.g. isu_int@acme (basic sign-in).

password.description: Password from the vault (basic sign-in).

access_token.description: OAuth access token from the vault (instead of user and password).

id_type.description: Whether integration_system_id holds the Integration System ID or the EIB's Workday ID (WID).

event_id.description: Integration event WID; pass it to Get integration event.

actions.name: Launch integration
actions.description: Start an integration system (such as an EIB) through the Integrations web service, optionally with launch parameter values, and return the event id to track it.

integration_system_id.description: Integration System ID of the integration to start.

user.description: Integration system user with tenant, e.g. isu_int@acme (basic sign-in).

password.description: Password from the vault (basic sign-in).

access_token.description: OAuth access token from the vault (instead of user and password).

id_type.description: Whether integration_system_id holds the Integration System ID or the integration's Workday ID (WID).

parameters.description: Launch parameter name to value; text, numbers, true/false and dates are sent with their Workday type.

event_id.description: Integration event WID; pass it to Get integration event.

actions.name: Search workers
actions.description: Find workers by name or id text.

access_token.description: OAuth access token from the vault.

search.description: Name or id text; all workers when empty.

name: Work queues
description: Add work items to a queue, take the next item, and mark items completed, failed or deferred with retries.

actions.name: Add work item
actions.description: Add one item (a Dictionary of fields) to a queue, optionally with a reference that is unique in the queue and tags.

reference.description: A name for the item that is unique in the queue, e.g. the invoice number.

if_exists.description: When an item with this reference is already there: error stops, skip leaves it, update gives it the new data and tags.

tags.description: Labels to find the item by, e.g. ["urgent", "north"].

central.description: Use the One CommandCenter queue with this name instead of the workspace's own file (runs started from One CommandCenter only).

item_id.description: New item id (or the id of the item with the same reference).

outcome.description: added, skipped (the reference was there and if_exists is skip) or updated.

name: XML
description: Query and change XML with XPath, convert to dictionaries and validate against XSD.

actions.name: Delete nodes
actions.description: Remove every element (or one attribute of each) that a path such as //order/note finds, in a file, in XML text or in a session.

xpath.description: XPath of the nodes to remove.

save_to.description: Save to another file instead of overwriting.

attribute.description: Remove only this attribute from the matched elements, keeping the elements.

xml.description: XML text to change instead of a file; the result is in the xml output.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace URI for prefixes in the XPath, e.g. {"inv": "urn:example:invoice"}; prefixes declared in the document work without this. Map a default namespace (xmlns="...") to a prefix of your choice to address it; a prefix with an empty URI, e.g. {"d": ""}, stands for the document's own default namespace.

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

actions.name: End session
actions.description: Close an XML session, optionally saving its XML first: over the file it was loaded from, or to another file.

save_in_place.description: Write the XML back to the file Start session loaded.

save_to.description: Write the XML to this file (used when not saving over the loaded file).

indent.description: Re-format the saved XML with indentation.

xml.description: The XML as the session held it.

path.description: The file written; empty when nothing was saved.

actions.name: Get multiple nodes
actions.description: Read the text of every element a path such as //order/id finds, as a list and as a table (one row per node, a column per part you name).

attribute.description: Return this attribute of each node instead of its text.

return_value.description: What to return for each node: its text, its XML, or its exact XPath.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace URI for prefixes in the XPath, e.g. {"inv": "urn:example:invoice"}; prefixes declared in the document work without this. Map a default namespace (xmlns="...") to a prefix of your choice to address it; a prefix with an empty URI, e.g. {"d": ""}, stands for the document's own default namespace.

columns.description: Columns of the table output: column name to an XPath read from each matching node (a child, an @attribute, or . for the node's own text).

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

values.description: Texts of matching nodes.

table.description: One row per matching node: the columns you named, or value and xpath when none are named.

actions.name: Get single node
actions.description: Read the text of the first element a path such as //order/id finds.

attribute.description: Return this attribute of the node instead of its text.

return_value.description: What to return: the node's text, its XML, or its exact XPath.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace URI for prefixes in the XPath, e.g. {"inv": "urn:example:invoice"}; prefixes declared in the document work without this. Map a default namespace (xmlns="...") to a prefix of your choice to address it; a prefix with an empty URI, e.g. {"d": ""}, stands for the document's own default namespace.

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

value.description: Node text, empty when nothing matches.

found.description: True when a node matched.

actions.name: Insert node
actions.description: Add an element, with its text and attributes, under, before or after every element a path finds.

save_to.description: Save to another file instead of overwriting.

position.description: end or start: last or first child of the matched node; before or after: next to the matched node, as its sibling.

if_exists.description: When the parent already has a child with this name (end/start only): add another, skip, or replace the first one.

xml.description: XML text to change instead of a file; the result is in the xml output.

reference_child.description: With position before or after: insert next to the first child of the matched node with this element name, instead of next to the matched node itself.

namespaces.description: Namespace declarations put on the new element, as prefix to URI (an empty prefix is the default namespace); name may then use the prefix, e.g. inv:note.

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

actions.name: Save XML file
actions.description: Check that XML text is well written and save it to a file, indented if you want.

indent.description: Re-format with indentation instead of keeping the text as given.

overwrite.description: Replace a file that is already there; when off, the step fails instead.

path.description: Full path of the written file.

actions.name: Update node
actions.description: Change the text (or an attribute) of every element a path finds, in a file, in XML text or in a session.

xpath.description: XPath of the nodes to change.

value.description: New text (or the attribute's new value).

save_to.description: Save to another file instead of overwriting.

attribute.description: Set this attribute (created when missing) instead of the node text.

xml.description: XML text to change instead of a file; the result is in the xml output.

attributes.description: Several attributes to set at once, as name to value (created when missing). With these, the node text changes only when value is filled in.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace URI for prefixes in the XPath, e.g. {"inv": "urn:example:invoice"}; prefixes declared in the document work without this. Map a default namespace (xmlns="...") to a prefix of your choice to address it; a prefix with an empty URI, e.g. {"d": ""}, stands for the document's own default namespace.

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

actions.name: Start session
actions.description: Load XML (a file or text) once as a named session, so later steps read and change it and End session saves it.

drop_blank_text.description: Remove text that is only spaces and line breaks between elements, so nodes hold only their real text.

share.description: Agents started from this one with Run agent may use this session by its name.
share.x-ooa-label: Agents this one runs may use it

actions.name: Convert to dictionary
actions.description: Turn XML (or the part a path finds) into a Dictionary; attributes become keys starting with @.

xpath.description: Convert only the first node matching this XPath.

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

actions.name: Validate XML
actions.description: Check that XML is well written and, if you give them, that it follows one or more XSD schemas or its DTD; gives the result instead of failing.

xsd_path.description: XSD schema file; without it only well-formedness is checked.

more_schemas.description: Further XSD files the document must follow together with xsd_path, e.g. one per namespace.

check_dtd.description: Check the document against its DTD: the one inside its DOCTYPE, or the file in dtd_path (a DTD the DOCTYPE points to elsewhere is never downloaded).

dtd_path.description: DTD file to check against; used for the DOCTYPE's outside DTD, or added when the document has no DOCTYPE.

session.description: Check the XML of this session (Start session).

valid.description: True when the document is valid.

actions.name: Evaluate XPath
actions.description: Work something out from XML with an XPath function, such as count(//line) or sum(//amount): text, a number or true/false.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace URI for prefixes in the XPath, e.g. {"inv": "urn:example:invoice"}; prefixes declared in the document work without this. Map a default namespace (xmlns="...") to a prefix of your choice to address it; a prefix with an empty URI, e.g. {"d": ""}, stands for the document's own default namespace.

session.description: Work on the XML of this session (Start session) instead of a file or text; changes stay in the session until End session saves them.

result.description: Result of the expression as String, Number or Boolean.

iterators.name: Each node in XML
iterators.description: Yield each node matching an XPath: its text, XML, XPath or an attribute.

attribute.description: Yield this attribute of each node instead of its text.

return_value.description: What to yield for each node: its text, its XML, or its exact XPath.

namespaces.description: Prefix to namespace URI for prefixes in the XPath, e.g. {"inv": "urn:example:invoice"}; prefixes declared in the document work without this. Map a default namespace (xmlns="...") to a prefix of your choice to address it; a prefix with an empty URI, e.g. {"d": ""}, stands for the document's own default namespace.

session.description: Go through the nodes of this XML session (Start session) instead of a file or text.
